title: Sign-in, session lifecycle, logout and safe return navigation
behavior: Accept normalized email and native secret, give one invalid-credentials response, renew valid sessions and reject expired/revoked/deleted identities at every domain operation. Better Auth replaces custom session hashing/cookies; preserve 30-day session life with renewal after remaining life falls below 15 days, immediate authoritative revocation and convergent repeated logout. A safe local return path preserves path/query and rejects external, protocol-relative, backslash-leading and control-character attacks. Login remains reachable with an expired cookie, so recovery cannot loop. Use an atomic shared attempt budget: login failure thresholds 5/normalized identifier and 20/trusted IP in a strict 15 minute window; success clears only that identifier/kind's in-window failures. Unknown IP skips only that IP axis, never identifier checks. Deployment must overwrite trusted IP headers. Concurrent attempts reserve/check budget under the same store rather than relying on request-local counts; budget store failure refuses authentication with a retryable message, without authenticating silently.

title: Registration and account-entity provisioning
behavior: Support planter, sending-church, network and explicit Discovery identities. Required normalized email, native password 8–1024 characters, display name and relevant organization name validate before effects. New organization provisioning produces that organization's Owner; planter onboarding produces one plant/Owner/Person; Discovery produces a profile without seat. Ordinary addressed invitations select only their advertised type/seat, never arbitrary user-supplied grants. Apply REQ-IDN-030, a unique login identifier, one active seat and idempotent provisioning. Registration's IP admission budget counts every submitted registration attempt (including success, duplicate, malformed, beta/refused and concurrent requests) at 3/hour per trustworthy known IP, distinct from login; an unavailable trustworthy IP refuses registration admission with a retryable message instead of bypassing its sole creation axis. Store/query failures refuse before grant. Do not expose account existence to senders.

title: Beta gate and meaningful invitation-origin registration
behavior: Retain an optional deployment-controlled beta gate, disabled by default for the fresh target unless explicitly enabled in that environment. An enabled gate accepts a valid configured code or an addressed live pending eligible invitation; forged, unrelated, expired or revoked invitations never bypass it. Account type choices follow the validated invitation subject. Show sufficient inviter/organization identity for informed acceptance, with no gate secret or sender-facing account-existence disclosure. Revalidate token and gate at submission.

title: Development and managed-preview account switching
behavior: Retain reproducible development/managed-preview persona switching only for fresh synthetic allowlisted fixture accounts. The server checks explicit environment enablement, supported fixture ID and intended environment before issuing a fixture session. Production defaults disable and exclude the action/surface; flags or client role strings cannot create production privilege. Never clone real/customer accounts into fixtures.

title: Current tenancy, capability and own-duty guards
behavior: Implement REQ-IDN-029 with one active account-seat constraint, typed tenant identity and fail-closed handling of inconsistent membership rows. Enforce authority on the server and when changing data, independently of hidden/read-only UI controls. Own seat, Discovery relationship, exact organization oversight and platform allowlist are distinct contexts, never pooled grants. Subject/own-duty guards remain narrower than generic routine administration. Return bounded DTOs; foreign/not-found records cannot disclose another tenant through detail, download, aggregate, cache or assistant paths.

title: Account avatar upload, replacement, removal and authenticated delivery
behavior: Native self avatar upload accepts nonempty JPG/JPEG/PNG/WebP up to 3 MiB with generated private keys and verified type. Authenticate delivery through an account/version route; no arbitrary raw key or bearer storage URL is returned. Upload new bytes, atomically save version/reference/audit, then cleanup old unreferenced bytes. A failed row update retains old avatar and schedules orphan cleanup; failed old-byte cleanup leaves new avatar usable. Removal clears reference before cleanup. Account deletion follows REQ-IDN-032.

title: Email change request, proof, confirmation and security notice
behavior: Native self requests a normalized valid different email with fresh supported identity/mailbox proof. Better Auth owns verification, proof expiry/supersession, unique login identity and the supported session policy; use a 24-hour email-change proof lifetime. Confirmation requires the authenticated request owner and live proof. Preserve account/Person identity; login-email change does not rewrite independently editable CRM email. After the supported auth call succeeds, append the truthful app security event and required old-address security-mail intent. App recording failure cannot undo a committed credential change, and uncertain calls are not recorded as success or retried with saved secrets. No custom credential-generation fence or credential-plus-app-event atomicity is promised. Throttle requests/failures by own login identifier 3/hour and trusted IP 10/hour so changing the target address cannot evade the budget; delivery failure preserves truthful request state.

title: Authenticated password change and other-session revocation
behavior: Require native current-secret proof for authenticated self and a different new secret of 8–1,024 characters, with immutable actor/current-session identity derived by the server. Better Auth owns the password change and built-in revocation; enable revokeOtherSessions and preserve only the eligible initiating session. Append the app security event and required security-mail intent after the supported call succeeds. A refused or unknown call has no success event; app recording failure cannot undo credentials or restore revoked sessions. Never put passwords or proof tokens in asynchronous jobs, and never use a custom credential-generation fence or promise credential-plus-app-event atomicity. Enforce a separate failure budget of 5/own normalized identifier and 20/trusted IP per 15 minutes. Validate malformed requests without probing the new secret against the old before current-secret proof.

title: Mailbox password recovery
behavior: Return the same bounded response/latency class for syntactically valid existing/nonexisting addresses and mail failure. Consume the separate budget of 3/normalized identifier and 10/trusted IP per hour before lookup. Better Auth owns live purpose-bound reset proofs, with a one-hour lifetime, single valid redemption and supported invalidation. Bind redemption to the addressed account, validate a confirmed different new secret of 8–1,024 characters and enable revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset so all prior sessions are revoked. Do not auto-sign-in. Append the truthful app security event and required mail intent after the supported reset succeeds; reporting or notice failure cannot undo the reset or restore sessions. No custom credential-generation fence, credential-plus-app-event atomicity or asynchronous password replay is allowed. Provider/database request failures remain internally observable without account enumeration.

title: Settings dialog, deep links and draft protection
behavior: Expose only known authorized account/church/association/team/organization/notification sections as typed DTOs. Use the v3 settings section links from design/handoff/screens.md with no v2 redirects. Preserve back/forward, focus/keyboard access and dirty draft protection across navigation/dismissal; a simpler shell is allowed. Preference auto save reports pending/error and restores server state on failure; rejected explicit save retains the user's draft. Server rechecks section owner/current scope/revision and cached results key exact actor/tenant. Personal timezone and deletion/cancellation native entry points integrate here; restricted deletion sessions cannot load normal settings. Affiliation settings use the same exact-organization category policy as privacy.setSharing: teams maps to ministry_teams and activityPush maps to activity; shared_findings is the single released-health/NI permission. An omitted category preserves its stored value. A nonempty closed patch binds current relationship and consent revisions, accepts only actual same-plant Owner/Admin, and commits through the shared organization helper in one all-or-nothing domain change. Organization roles cannot edit plant consent; stale/missing/revoked policies refuse without reset or partial effects.

title: Church profile, locality, timezone, inactivity and digest schedule
behavior: Owner/Admin edit plant name and independent nullable street/city/region/country/profile fields; validate trimmed nonempty name and bounded fields, IANA timezone, weekday 0–6/hour 0–23, inactivity warning/alert 1–365 with warning<alert. Fresh defaults are America/Chicago and weekly digest Sunday 16:00. Street is excluded from organization directory/oversight; configured locality uses the shared geography contract. Timezone changes preview future schedules/reminders; past instants, LocalDate deadlines and one-time appointments remain. Inactivity/overdue computations use church-local dates. Missing optional locality is not an inferred population/area.

title: Per-account notification preferences, cadence and self suppression recovery
behavior: Expose current audience's closed category/channel/daily-weekly cadence preference matrix and truthful suppression state. Save only the authenticated account's allowed preferences, with rollback/visible error on refusal. Self suppression-clear applies only its current proven mailbox and does not grant unrelated consent; enabled org push preference cannot override plant consent. Notification-owned scheduling/digest contracts provide actual delivery, including Sunday 16:00 default weekly digest. No private-care preference/nudge metadata reaches email or assistant.

title: Church creation, onboarding basics and account-person bootstrap
behavior: For a proven eligible account create one plant, Owner membership, all-OFF self-start sharing settings and one stable account-linked CRM Person as part of the same all-or-nothing domain change. Trim required plant name; allow partial independent locality. Repeated intent returns the same plant; simultaneous seat acceptance/creation cannot create a second active seat, orphan authority or stray Person. Account-linked Owner is CRM leader-stage bootstrap history, not proof of commitment/adult eligibility. Actual church creation enters Phase 1, with a once-only church_creation history variant from no previous plant phase; it does not attest an existing journey or mark readiness/reading complete. Retry returns the actual current phase without overwriting later history. A successful basics step cannot be reentered to provision again. Global canonical seed is separate from customer creation.

title: Leadership attestation and onboarding prompts
behavior: Retain the yes/no onboarding question as ordinary CRM/ministry-role data. Yes visibly assigns the ordinary lead ministry role to the existing Owner Person, reusing its role/container or creating only the shown minimal necessary role/container; no whole-template import occurs. A separate optional selected Senior Pastor template fill uses the ordinary membership operation and only a vacant selected role. No leaves routine Owner authority intact and shows no fabricated lead. A separate operating lead is a real Person with ordinary role and independently accepted Admin invitation where needed. The selected role/import preview discloses assignment, preserves an occupied/explicit leader and never copies readers/private care. Source vacant-owner claim/attestation privilege flows are superseded; no target operation activates authority from the answer. Missing lead title never suppresses required evaluation/follow-up: explicit eligible assignment or Needs owner remains visible.

title: Journey declaration, launch-date setup, completion and resume
behavior: Persist basics/lead answer/journey/People facts and derive resume from them. Optional steps may be skipped; finishing stamps onboarding completion once and affected assessment freshness without claiming all facts are complete or generating an assessment synchronously. Existing-journey declaration is optional human attestation, separate from actual creation-entry Phase 1. A saved unsure/discerning/skip answer can complete that setup step but is not an attestation and keeps actual creation Phase 1. It never silently maps back to Phase 0; later explicit validated reasoned phase correction remains available. Native launch plan accepts no-date and cannot clear an existing schedule accidentally during onboarding; phase and launch writes are a single reviewed resumable intent if they cannot share the short transaction. Back/reentry cannot rerun finished provisioning. Missing facts remain visible after finish; no mandatory six-article gate for actual Phase 1 creation.

title: Discovery identity, associations and conversion to plant
behavior: Maintain explicit Discovery profile and scoped sending-church/network relationships without any organization seat. Seatless former Member is not automatically Discovery. Conversion by the proven profile owner validates current account/profile state, creates plant at Phase 1 with once-only creation-entry provenance plus Owner/Person and transfers only chosen disclosed relationships/sharing choices in one all-or-nothing domain change, retiring the Discovery profile with history. Associated Discovery must resolve/leave incompatible association before ordinary first-seat acceptance; no automatic tenancy move. Race conversion, relationship edit and invitation claim under the same account eligibility and one-active-seat rules.

title: Seat invitation create, pending list, resend, revoke, expire and first-seat acceptance
behavior: Owner/Admin invite ordinary Admin/Member into their exact workspace. Keep addressed hashed purpose token, pending→accepted/expired/revoked, 30 elapsed-day expiry, at most 3 new invitation attempts per exact workspace/address in 30 elapsed days, persistent 60 elapsed-second resend cool down and one pending subject/address intent. Resend rotates token after current state/cool down check; revoke/accept/resend race has one winner. Pending lists/sender responses redact account-resolution data. Proven existing seatless account may accept its first seat; new account uses REQ-IDN-030. Refuse already active-seat accounts, wrong mailbox, malformed target/type, expired/revoked/superseded token and incompatible associated Discovery rather than moving tenancy. Validate when accepting the invitation; mail retry returns the same invitation receipt.

title: Seat roster, Admin appointment/demotion and authority removal
behavior: Owner/Admin manage ordinary same-workspace Admin/Member seats under current role and unchanged reviewed seat. Protect actual Owner; deny self-promotion, foreign target, generic Owner removal and role changes that violate one-active-seat integrity. Joined date uses accepted invite provenance or clearly labelled original-account fallback. Removal revokes membership authority/sessions, retains CRM/account link and qualification/team history, clears access-dependent team leadership, and presents exact actionable-duty handoff to a currently eligible recipient or visible Needs owner. Closed/waived/deleted duties remain closed. A role or seat change applies its access, duty and audit consequences together, or names exactly what moved and what remains; it never reports success after hidden partial work. Removal is not account deletion/ownership transfer.

title: Organization relationship invitations across five subject types
behavior: Support five scoped subjects: plant→sending church, plant→network, sending church→network, Discovery→sending church and Discovery→network. A plant Owner/Admin initiates its link; one exact receiving organization's Owner/Admin approves that organization, with no delegation or all-affiliate veto. Each link has independent state/consent and typed matching subject IDs. Keep normalized mailable recipient, 30 day expiry, at most 3 new invites/address in the rolling configured 30 day invitation window, no duplicate pending intent and exact readable inviter description. Creation/response/resend/revoke validates current actor/subject/revision. Multiple independent valid affiliations may coexist; competing acceptance cannot silently replace existing links or consent. Accepted receipt queues notice to plant, retries converge and mail failure does not undo a committed relationship.

title: Relationship leaving, organization severing and association history
behavior: An authorized subject-side Owner/Admin may leave exactly its own affiliation; exact own-org Owner/Admin may end only that organization's link with confirmation and retryable notice to the plant. Preserve other affiliations and independent access paths. Append typed actor/org/subject/source-invite/time/reason history for plant, sending-church and Discovery subjects; do not fabricate missing legacy history. Repeated sever returns the existing/no-effect outcome and no duplicate event. Current entitlement is removed immediately for that link's bodies/results/caches while minimal allowed relationship history remains. Returning through a new ordinary approved invitation preserves history and existing per-org consent; no special rejoin restoration engine.

title: Privacy pull sharing, push consent and first-invitation defaults
behavior: Store each accepted plant/org pair's approved aggregate categories and separate activity push consent. Self-start defaults all OFF; accepted first invitation discloses active categories default ON for that exact organization, with later independent ON/OFF changes. Never reset previous consent on rejoin or another-org acceptance. Retain People/Meetings/Tasks/Teams/Wiki aggregate categories, independent activity push consent, and the existing shared_findings permission for released health/NI findings. The permitted categories are People, Meetings, Tasks, Teams, Wiki, activity push and shared findings. Each applies only to its own approved projection. Activity remains independently stored push consent in the same sharing command; shared_findings is one existing permission, with no second NI consent. Finance/facility/background/coach/private-care categories are absent. Missing relationship/settings fail closed. Turning a category OFF stops new reads/results/cache reuse/dispatch from it, without hiding the basic relationship directory or unaffected affiliates; coarse relationship notice must not name restricted toggle or body. Org preferences cannot authorize pull data.

title: Oversight dashboard, plant directory, consent-gated aggregates and health entry
behavior: List only current own-org related plants. Basic directory gives plant name/partial locality excluding street, attested phase/launch context, provenance and ordinary lead ministry-role Person display name (not assumed Owner); no contacts/private CRM. Aggregate sections distinguish withheld, shared-empty, shared-populated and unavailable: distinct People/status totals, recent 12 meeting cadence/attended totals, top-level actionable task counts/overdue, operational team/staffing/training coverage and Wiki reading counts. Each section uses its current consent and domain denominator; checklist/waived/cancelled tasks cannot inflate open counts. Organization intelligence/health uses its separate exact-org consent/release lineage and published-summary producer; same native/Evry bounded read. Sharing OFF/revoked affiliation removes cached/current/history body access that depends on it; unknown/foreign target is indistinguishable.

title: Network sending-church roster and member detail
behavior: Network readers list/detail only sending churches currently associated with that exact network and pending unexpired scoped relationship invitations. Member detail lists only plants that both relate to that sending church and separately have a valid same-network relationship; parent hierarchy does not manufacture plant access. Counts exclude expired/revoked invitations and foreign-network plants. Empty states explain actual scope; links go through current per-plant consent-filtered overview. Sending-church seat does not gain network roster authority.

title: Organization profile and account/workspace deletion boundaries
behavior: Implement the accepted target follow-through for formerly unwired organization settings: exact own sending-church/network Owner/Admin edit bounded name/contact/profile fields with protected org kind/identity, current state and audit. No billing, ownership transfer, delete-org or wider intelligence/CRM access is implied. Personal self deletion and Owner-only church workspace deletion follow REQ-IDN-032 with explicit review, shared church history/minimal attribution and restricted native cancellation. Admin/Member/CRM lead cannot delete workspace or another login. Leaving Owner who keeps church running uses external manual exception; no claim/transfer/special rejoin UI.

title: Relationship removal through authorized domain operations
behavior: Uncalled direct-FK-null helpers are not separate user operations. Replace their alias semantics with the actor-bearing, typed, versioned, audited exact-link commands of IDN-021. No unguarded disassociate helper appears in the native or assistant target catalog; every relationship end shares recorded outcome and history/notice and current entitlement removal.

title: Request boundary, CSRF exceptions, trusted routing and expired-session recovery
behavior: Cookie presence may optimize GET routing but never proves authentication. Login/session recovery remains reachable; every private route/API/action validates current session and subject. Overwrite any internal routed-URL stamp with the real URL; crawler scope is derived from real allowlisted public Wiki path plus UA and returns only approved public metadata, never trusted client crawler/stamp headers. Mutating browser requests require configured canonical scheme/host/port Origin, with trusted deployment Host validation; reject missing/malformed/cross origin and HEAD/OPTIONS mutation attempts under the declared allowlist. Exact independently authenticated exception routes are Resend raw-body signature webhook and sealed disable-only unsubscribe POST; GET unsubscribe is read only confirmation, wrong/expired/purpose tokens uniformly fail without mutating. Undo uses separate enable-only short proof and normal native origin. Jobs have a distinct bounded signed job end point admission, never a broad origin less prefix bypass. Safe return rejects external/protocol relative/backslash/control chars. Each admitted request still executes authoritative domain policy.

title: People directory, search, filters, page numbers and views
behavior: Preserve list/card/pipeline views, search of display name/email/phone, closed status/source filters and all-selected-tags AND semantics in navigable URL state. Hide retired contacts from active directory. Bound requests 1–100 with 24 row default UI pages; changing filter/search/view returns to page 1 while preserving sibling filters. Owner decision D67 (2026-10-19): list, cards and pipeline columns use page numbers (?page=N) in deterministic createdAt+ID order; the server takes the church from the session, and a page past the end shows the last page or an empty state, never an error. Treat search metacharacters literally. Inactive badges use current church-local threshold and effective confirmed-contact date, not email opens or administrative tasks. Full basic contact/address fields remain operationally available only under current tenant DTO policy.

title: Create, quick-add and edit person profiles
behavior: Preserve contact, independent address/source/sourceDetails/summary notes and stage fields with server validation after trim. Normal full form names allow bounded 255 character components; reject wholly blank display identity. A minimum named guest may supply one real display name with optional phone/email and no fabricated surname. Quick defaults are prospect, source other (meeting quick-add uses meeting_guest_list), and optional US country default shown/editable. Explicit null clears nullable fields rather than blank→undefined losing the edit. Users cannot set the account link or creator. Every create and edit shows in the person's history. Creating or editing a person does not imply account, adult, commitment, consent or safety clearance. Background-check fields are excluded from every current form/DTO/import/export/tool.

title: Person retirement and service-only restore
behavior: Use attributable soft retirement, preserving authorized CRM relations/history and private file references; remove from active queries/selectors and prevent new current references. Review actionable assigned duties and household/leadership/assignment effects before committing; unresolved work remains explicitly Needs owner rather than disappears. Native/reviewed restore rechecks tenant/revision, restores only an ordinary retired Person and recomputes current eligibility; it does not restore account seats or transfer private care. Merged sources are denied ordinary restore and routed to reviewed Unmerge. Retired history remains discoverable under current permission. Organization pipeline Persons use the same applicable identity, lifecycle, duplicate, merge, reference and inverse rules within their exact organization under REQ-MUL-001 and REQ-MUL-005; plant-only recruitment/household/commitment facts remain plant-only.

title: Account-linked contacts and recruited-contact identity
behavior: Maintain one live same plant Person per account through a partial uniqueness arbiter. Owner bootstrap and accepted ordinary seat link reuse an exact already-linked identity; otherwise show/select a same-email active unlinked contact only when verified non ambiguous, or create a new linked Person. Never choose the oldest ambiguous email match as identity proof or steal another link; client cannot set accountId. Seat removal/email change retains stable account-link history and independently editable CRM email. Recruited-contact source composition remains distinct from all-currently-committed adult size: bootstrap alone is no recruitment/commitment evidence, while a login holder with real adult active commitment may count. Organization pipeline Persons use the same applicable identity, lifecycle, duplicate, merge, reference and inverse rules within their exact organization under REQ-MUL-001 and REQ-MUL-005; plant-only recruitment/household/commitment facts remain plant-only.

title: Private person photo lifecycle
behavior: Apply 3 MiB verified JPG/JPEG/PNG/WebP private image policy and same plant live Person authority. Only people who can see the person can see the photo, through the app and never through a raw storage link. Replacing or removing a photo never shows a broken or someone else's image. Foreign/retired photo access returns unavailable. Merge may choose either person's stored photo and keeps the other while an unmerge may need it. A failed upload keeps the old photo.

title: Manual recruitment-stage movement, warnings, reasons and handoff
behavior: Allow all 7 closed stages, deliberate forward skips and backward moves with shown skipped-stage guidance, actor/date/reason and unchanged reviewed state. Same-stage is a no-op outcome. Use one change-stage command from profile and pipeline so profile edit cannot bypass warnings. Leaving committed statuses core_group/launch_team/leader offers exact open-duty handoff to current eligible owner or explicit decline/Needs owner; no hidden partial loop. Stage change alone never withdraws commitment, changes adult classification or revokes earned training/seat. Recording interview/commitment or correction never incidentally demotes an advanced stage.

title: Recruitment pipeline grouping, ordering, inactivity and follow-up warnings
behavior: Preserve five visible pipeline columns with final core-group column also containing launch_team/leader milestone badges. Moving a person within or between columns keeps the order every viewer sees, changes only that person and never another church's or a retired contact; a move based on an outdated view of the column is refused with a clear message. Read-only viewers have no drag mutation. Cards display only active parent follow-up work and due-local-day overdue/missing warnings. Complete/no_longer_needed/deleted obligations do not show open urgency; a contact without any explicitly created duty may be uncovered but is not invented urgent work. A person with no recorded activity for longer than the church's inactivity threshold in Settings shows an inactivity warning on their card; new activity clears it. Page/bound queries without dropping full filtered result semantics.

title: Activity timeline and authored-note create/edit/delete
behavior: Typed activity timeline pages by number in event Instant+ID order (D67), preserving tied timestamps and visible performer/provenance. Notes validate nonblank bounded 5000 characters; author alone edits/deletes their own note under exact Person/kind/tenant/revision. Edit preserves original occurrence and actor, appends old/new/current author/editedAt/reason correction; delete removes current note body with attributable tombstone/history subject to shared-record deletion policy. Summary profile notes remain separate fields. System audit/qualification events are not user-editable notes. Meeting-linked note must validate actual meeting/attendance relation server-side. Organization pipeline Persons use the same applicable identity, lifecycle, duplicate, merge, reference and inverse rules within their exact organization under REQ-MUL-001 and REQ-MUL-005; plant-only recruitment/household/commitment facts remain plant-only.

title: Household lifecycle, member roles and deliberate address propagation
behavior: Tenant household name/address and head/spouse/child/other membership roles are operational facts, not adult classification. Create household+initial head coherently; join validates live same plant Person/household and copies household address only if Person lacks meaningful address. Leaving preserves Person address. Address propagation previews exact active members/current reviewed state and deliberately overwrites them all at once, returning the actual count. Empty-household deletion refuses active members; retired member references detach from current household while history still shows the household a retired person belonged to. Concurrent Person retirement, household joining and deletion cannot leave orphan records.

title: Church-defined tags and person assignment
behavior: Keep church-defined tags with a name trimmed of leading and trailing spaces, 1–100 characters. Normalize names with lower(btrim(name)); names differing only by case or surrounding spaces share the same plant-local unique key (plant_id, normalized_name). Internal spaces remain significant. Color is nullable: omission on update keeps the saved color, null clears it, and a supplied color must be a supported named or hex color. There is no archived-tag state or archived-tag filter. Assignment validates live Person and tag in the same plant and a unique pair. Retried assign/remove returns one semantic activity or the original no-op outcome. Rename updates views/export; deletion previews linked count, removes current links and preserves attributable history without becoming a global taxonomy.

title: Skills, gifts, proficiency and category grouping
behavior: Preserve categories worship/tech/admin/teaching/hospitality/leadership/other, optional proficiency beginner/intermediate/advanced/expert, trimmed skill name 1–100 and bounded 5000 character notes. Add/edit/remove have unchanged reviewed state and atomic activity/correction; category grouping and null clear roundtrip. Retire removed current item while preserving owned history. Recorded skill search/organization is allowed; it does not replace human Gifted interview criterion or infer calling/readiness.

title: SME 4 C’s assessment recording, latest result and history
behavior: Record dated human Committed/Compelled/Contagious/Courageous assessment, each integer 1–5 and optional bounded 5000 character lens notes. Compute total 4–20 server-side and enforce score/total integrity. Preserve all records, actor/occurrence date/recorded instant and latest ordering by assessment LocalDate, recordedAt, ID; late historical entry cannot become latest merely by recording time. Advisory early-stage warning is not a hard gate. Recording does not change stage. Correction is REQ-PPL-015 and never supplies model person judgment.

title: SME five-criterion interview, result, next steps and progression
behavior: Keep all five criteria Maturity/Gifted/Chemistry/Right Reasons/Season as pass/fail/concern with dated human notes, next steps and result qualified/qualified_with_notes/not_qualified/follow_up. ANY result means interview occurred; on lower earlier stage record interviewed progression atomically, while an already core_group/launch_team/leader remains advanced. Only explicit stage command demotes. Chronological latest and attributable history match assessments. Next steps remain recorded text; intended-but-undelivered automatic task prompts are not registered as automation. A user can explicitly draft/create named task through ordinary Task command.

title: Commitment recording, private document and Core Group entry
behavior: Preserve core_group/launch_team commitment types, actual signed LocalDate, optional witness/notes/private PDF/JPG/PNG≤10 MiB and authenticated document download. Witness is an optional same plant Person selected from valid tenant record; unstructured external witness may be dated text without a foreign Person reference. Files up to 10 MiB upload through the shared private-file flow; a failed upload leaves no attached file. Saving a commitment shows the document, the Core Group stage and the history together, and marks affected assessments out of date. Advanced stage is not demoted by repeat card. Explicit dated withdrawal/reactivation changes person lifecycle not stage; old signature cannot override withdrawal. Apply REQ-PPL-026 for current adult size/genuine history.

title: Correct assessment, interview and commitment records
behavior: Correct exact same plant Person/record kind under current Owner/Admin and unchanged reviewed record. Reuse original domain validations; recompute assessment total, preserve original recording actor/time and show the old value, new value, who and why in history. Ordinary score/result/notes/occurrence date correction never replays stage automation. Immutable original account/private author cannot be changed. Document/witness/original assessor replacement is outside ordinary correction fields; no arbitrary field patch or universal Undo. Use explicit new evidence record where necessary, retaining previous private document and provenance under ownership/deletion rules. Invalid historical commitment/lifecycle may be voided/corrected with attributable history and recomputed current projection, preserving earlier assessments. A correction based on an outdated view, another person's record or another church writes nothing; repeating a correction changes nothing more.

title: Duplicate hints and duplicate-pair review directory
behavior: Return active same plant exact/potential/no-match hints from normalized email/phone/name; ignore empty/short contact signals and escape SQL wildcards literally. Family name/shared mailbox is only hint, never unique human identity or mandatory merge. Import hints redact to ID/display name. Pair review requires current reviewed state and disclose conservative blocked merge cause. User may intentionally create duplicate with explicit choice; no foreign retired row or model identity judgment leaks.

title: Reviewed duplicate merge and survivor navigation
behavior: Implement REQ-PPL-024 and REQ-PPL-025 as the complete merge/retirement/reference/inverse contract. Preserve field choice preview, account-link survivor protection, private photo choice, source and correction history, exact conflict checks, retry-safe recorded outcome and acyclic merged-source redirects. The required Unmerge inverse stays available; raw restore cannot replace it. Historical source callable identity is unavailable in current evidence and no implemented source symbol is claimed. Every later consumer's actual reference integration must pass before that package closes.

title: CSV template, preview, row validation, duplicate resolutions and partial import
behavior: Use RFC 4180 parser with BOM/CRLF/commas/escaped quotes/quoted multiline and explicit malformed quoting errors. Keep 12 contact input columns(first_name, last_name, email, phone, street, city, state, postal_code, country, source, source_details, notes); normalizer/defaults match People and background fields are absent. Server limits 10 MiB and 10000 rows and validates the uploaded file itself, never rows returned by the client. Preview all valid/invalid/existing and within-file duplicate rows; resolutions skip/create/create_and_review never overwrite existing Person. Import saves exactly the rows the user reviewed; each row is created, skipped or failed, with an optional new duplicate-review pair. A retry never creates a person twice. A changed file, review or authority is refused. A partial import names each failed row and why, and what remains, never a generic failure after rows were saved.

title: Filtered CSV export and file serialization
behavior: Export same current filters as directory with 15 documented columns: first_name, last_name, email, phone, street, city, state, postal_code, country, status, source, source_details, notes, tags, created_at; tags semicolon joined and recorded createdAt UTC. Header-only empty export valid. RFC 4180 escaping preserves comma/newline/quotes; spreadsheet-dangerous leading=,+,-,@, TAB/CR values get documented leading apostrophe neutralization. The exact bytes are CSV not an XLSX claim. Private photo/account/storage/qualification/background/care fields are absent. Tenant read/export authority rechecked; an export of any size finishes and states its filters and row count. Narrow 12 column import ignores status/tags/date, so never claim lossless backup/roundtrip. Organization pipeline Persons use the same applicable identity, lifecycle, duplicate, merge, reference and inverse rules within their exact organization under REQ-MUL-001 and REQ-MUL-005; plant-only recruitment/household/commitment facts remain plant-only.

title: Recorded events and cross-domain recruitment auto-advancement
behavior: Preserve only conditional source transitions: attended Vision prospect→attendee, active ministry membership core_group→launch_team, ordinary ministry leadership launch_team→leader. Interview event advances earlier stage to interviewed, commitment earlier stage to core_group; repeated recording/correction preserves advanced stage. When the attendance, membership, leadership, interview or commitment is saved, the stage advance is visible at the same time, with its history. Recording it again adds no history. No automatic demotion on role leave, training revoke, commitment withdrawal or plant launch date/phase change.

title: Person teams, training and communication tabs
behavior: Project own ing Teams/Training/Communication data under exact Person/tenant current permission; merge redirects and retired history consistent. Show distinct current membership plus dated former tenure; explicit assigned training obligations separate from earned/revoked/former completion history. Actual email sent/accepted/delivered/opened/clicked/bounced/failed are distinct from typed human contact logs; contact badge must not claim provider mail delivery. Empty/unavailable states explain truth and read-only user has no send control. Dates use church zone intentionally; tabs never widen scope.

title: Explicit follow-up creation and task suggestions
behavior: The uncalled deferred follow-up-initiation warning and undelivered interview next-step automatic task prompt are not executable target capabilities. Consolidate useful intent into explicit ordinary follow-up create/assign or reviewed task creation, retaining manualfollowing_up stage. Nothing creates follow-ups, qualifications, stage changes or tasks automatically in the background. Show recorded next steps as text with option to explicitly open a task draft.

title: Internal pipeline transition metrics with known cohorts
behavior: Retain the useful source helper behavior as an internal authenticated same-tenant aggregate query. Count distinct active canonical Persons per current stage at a frozen asOf/revision; separately count distinct Persons with each exact adjacent forward transition within an explicit occurrence-date window, deduplicating repeated forward/backward moves. Preserve the actual historical transition source/revision and name the event window and unit. A conversion rate requires a reconstructable distinct source-stage-at-window cohort; when that denominator cannot be established, return Unknown with the known transition count, never combine current stage population with historical event counts. Do not use these rates as readiness or silently substitute them for named Plant Intelligence metrics. No new visible widget, Evry tool, separate analytics service or actorless helper API is added. The source unmounted status is provenance, not authority to remove the internal useful query.

title: Meeting list, detail and history
behavior: Preserve upcoming/past/all windows, closed type filter, stable paging and one derived display title across detail/bread crumb. Browse defaults all; analytics defaults Vision and labels that scope. Unknown/repeated type query gets the documented all default. Cancelled future records remain distinguishable from scheduled; an empty current filter does not claim no historical meetings. Team tab and global list reuse the same records with current tenant projection.

title: Create, edit, delete and change meeting status
behavior: Retain vision_meeting/orientation/team_meeting and subtypes regular/training/planning/special/rehearsal; add approved distinct prelaunch_practice type. States planning/ready/in_progress/completed/cancelled; reviewed-state transitions are explicit. Type/team linkage cannot change through ordinary edit. Creating a meeting saves its venue details, agenda, kit and roster together; later venue edits do not change past meetings. Vision numbers stay distinct even when two meetings are created at once. Entered times keep their meaning across time zones and daylight saving changes. Delete from current list through attributable retirement; void an invalid occurrence separately, preserving history and actual held evidence. Completed practice requires actual nonfuture occurrence; three distinct valid held completed IDs meet practice count, four still meet. Scheduled/future/cancelled/not-held/duplicate/voided records do not count. Practice supports ordinary venue/agenda/guest/notes, but no Vision number/kit/card/evaluation/first-timer work or training credit. Correction/reopen/void changes current facts with history, never auto phase or milestones.

title: Meeting venues and copied location details
behavior: Keep name/address/contact/cost/capacity/notes and active state; capacity≥1 when supplied, valid bounded contact/email/cost input and tenant fields. Selection requires active same plant venue and copies name/address as meeting facts. Current venue edits do not rewrite old meeting snapshots; choosing a new future venue is explicit. Creation from picker joins meeting unit of work. Current list hides archived with explicit history inclusion.

title: Archive, restore and correct venues
behavior: Discover archived venues, restore deliberately and retain all linked meeting records. Unchanged reviewed state correction/archive/restore writes current state and old/new/corrector/time/reason atomically. Stale edit writes neither row nor history; no-op active-state request converges. Existing unchanged archived selection may remain on a meeting; new/reselected archived location is refused. Restore does not rewrite historical copied venue facts.

title: Structured meeting agenda and Vision defaults
behavior: Agenda sections have stable ID, trimmed title 1–120 and integer duration 0–600 minutes; at most 40 sections, empty valid. Save validates entire payload with named errors, never silently drops/truncates invalid API sections. Vision default is Welcome 10, Worship 15, Vision 25, Q&A 15, Response 10, Fellowship 15 minutes (90 total), fresh IDs and immutable source version. Non Vision starts empty. Add/remove/reorder/retime roundtrip and derived total; later reference revision never overwrites a user's agenda.

title: Vision kit checklist
behavior: Retain canonical versioned kit categories essential/materials/setup/av/organization with item text, assigned Person, check state and bounded notes. Seed exact reviewed kit once with meeting create or explicit accepted offer; repeated population converges. Assignee must be live same plant, all ownership, reference and current-state rules checked; uncheck reverses check and summary counts actual checked rows. Non Vision including practice cannot request kit. Read never seeds missing rows silently.

title: Guests, inviters and team roster snapshot
behavior: One meeting/Person guest row, invited initially absent and optional valid same plant inviter distinct from Person. Team roster expands current active memberships to unique live Persons, snapshots at creation/import and does not dynamically follow later joins/leaves. Explicit roster reconciliation previews additions/removals and current reviewed state. Guest remove cancels pending linked reminders/tokens and removes current card with history, preserving unrelated Person/contact/outcome evidence; performed work cannot be undone by removal. Read joins email tracking without turning engagement into presence.

title: Administrative RSVP correction
behavior: Owner/Admin may set confirmed/declined or reset null=Pending for exact guest/Person/meeting/tenant under current state. Use one authoritative guest RSVP projection: admin change appends provenance, synchronizes recognized linked invitation response and supersedes pending bearer tokens so an old token cannot overwrite the correction. Reset returns Pending and invalidates old tokens; a new outgoing invitation explicitly mints a fresh token. It never changes attendance/card/contact/mail delivery. This resolves the source attendance-only inconsistency rather than retaining 2 current truths.

title: Own RSVP and public token response
behavior: Authenticated own reply binds current account→live Person→existing guest inside the transaction and accepts only confirmed/declined. No client Person/account ID establishes subject. Public page view is read-only; purpose token must be live addressed meeting/guest, pending, unexpired/unrevoked and single-response. Atomically set canonical RSVP for the exact guest and token, claim/supersede pending tokens and update recognized invitation artifact; concurrent own/admin/token response has one current winner. Missing session 401, invalid 400, denied 403, unavailable 404; token links disclose only bounded invite context. Attendance/card/notes/delivery untouched.

title: Attendance, check-in and walk-ins
behavior: Retain attended/absent/excused and first_time/returning/core_group categories with one guest row. For Vision first-time use prior chronologically earlier actually attended Vision only; team/orientation/practice/RSVP never substitutes. Core-group category remains distinct from first/returning and captures committed-stage evidence basis at recording/finalized snapshot, not later automatic stage edit. Finalized historical classification changes only reviewed correction; late prior Vision correction recomputes affected current eligibility/obligation delta with history. The whole batch validates current Person eligibility and commits all or none; own team leader only its attendance. Leader clear changes presence only, retaining guest/RSVP/card. Unknown row refuses instead of false success; summary counts attended Persons, including actual planter attendance.

title: Quick-add meeting guests and attendees
behavior: Quick existing Person attachment validates live exact tenant and duplicates/merge policy. Quick new named contact uses the People minimal name/contact validation, source meeting_guest_list/prospect and shown country default. Person+guest and optional walk-in presence commit with one recorded outcome; failed/foreign/invalid meeting cannot leave orphan new contact. Creating guest/walk in grants no login, consent, adulthood or commitment. Same-name hint does not automatically merge.

title: Finalize and reconcile attendance
behavior: Implement REQ-MTG-020/021. Finalizing applies all consequences or none. Repeating an unchanged finalize changes nothing and shows the earlier result; a correction shows what changed. Late same-count replacements and removal towards 0 are identity deltas. Required generated effects are in exact review and missing assignee shown Needs owner. Meeting completed status is independent; neither means cards/evaluation/contact finished.

title: Response cards and recorded outcomes
behavior: Owner/Admin record/correct/clear one card per existing guest/meeting/Person: ready_commit/interested/prayer_request/stay_informed/not_interested, bounded prayer/question notes and recorder/occurred/recorded time. Clear returns no-card with correction tombstone; no-card is Unknown not negative. Report attended card population separately from absent guest cards and denominator, including zero/missing Unknown; do not infer attendance, email consent or commitment. Sensitive prayer/question notes require purpose-specific authorized projection and no automatic summary or AI counsel; public RSVP never reads or writes them. Non Vision/practice card denied.

title: Vision evaluation and trends
behavior: Only Vision allows one human evaluation with integer 1–5 for 8 factor keys: attendanceScore (Great Attendance: Core Group actively inviting); locationScore (Acceptable Location: easy to find/welcoming/distraction-free); logisticsScore (Great Logistics: room/AV/materials ready); agendaScore (Clear Agenda: detailed and on time); vibeScore (Great Vibe: warm/inviting/enthusiastic); messageScore (Compelling Message: clear vision); closeScore (Strong Close: nonmanipulative call); nextStepsScore (Clear Next Steps: dates/details). Server computes arithmetic average rounded 1 decimal and records who evaluated and when. Submitting the evaluation completes the evaluation task. Two people submitting at once produce one evaluation; the second sees the first. The evaluation trend across meetings is a report; recording an evaluation is not. No model scores factors.

title: Correct a Vision evaluation
behavior: Correct allowed factor/notes under Owner/Admin, current meeting and unchanged reviewed row. Append old/new/actor/time/reason atomically, recompute average and source revision; stale edit creates no history. Current comparisons/PI use corrected effective evidence, while old receipts/snapshots remain interpretable. Correction never re-emits first evaluation completion or completes managed task again; task reopen requires separate explicit command.

title: Meeting analytics and evaluation comparison
behavior: Preserve attended trend, new-versus-returning, completed meeting summary/growth and quality comparison with labelled type/window. Count actual attended unique Persons, not all guest rows. Zero prior attendance gets defined zero/relative growth Unavailable, never false/missing-missing; no denominator/evidence gives Unknown not 0. Evaluation base line uses earlier chronological evaluations, excludes self/same instant and uses up to the 50 most recent evaluations before this meeting. Round base line then delta 1 decimal as retained source calculation. Corrected records feed current comparison with provenance. This is a report.

title: Attendee notes in person history
behavior: Validate current meeting/Person/guest-attendance relation within plant before bounded trimmed 1–5000 character note. Derive meeting type/ID from server and append authored Person activity with actual performer, meeting provenance and recorded instant atomically. Own note edit/delete follows People history contract; client metadata cannot forge unrelated meeting or Person link. No privileged broad note edit or private care classification is created.

title: Meeting notifications and invitation communication
behavior: Retain announcement to linked Core Group accounts and 7/3/1 civil-day-before reminders at same church wall clock to creator+linked guests, deduplicated per logical meeting offset/recipient. Skip already-passed offsets, cancel completed/cancelled/retired meeting intents, and reschedule/reconcile guests using expected source revision and durable intent. Dispatch rechecks actual current audience/status/consent/suppression; removed recipient cannot receive queued new message. Canonical meeting invitation/reminder email templates and purpose RSVP tokens are separate Communication Hub effects with accepted/delivered/unknown outcomes; scheduled notification never claims attendance/card/contact. Use shared automatic DST resolver and one occurrence dedupe.

title: Invitation attribution
behavior: Preserve valid stored inviter/recognized invitation response provenance and Person merge references in the bounded meeting guest/RSVP artifact model. Current inviter requires live own-plant Person and no self-referral cycle. Legacy invited/confirmed/maybe/declined/attended/no_show historical attribution may remain readable with original meaning, but does not drive presence or replace canonical RSVP. Unwritten legacy create helper/schema is not an approved stand alone invitation tree/name-only prospect subsystem; named real guest creates People through MTG-011. Merge/inverse manifest registers artifact and token refs with collision checks.

title: Task views, search, filters and counts
behavior: Preserve My/All/Assignments, title search, closed status/priority/category/relation filters and sorting by due, priority, status, title or creation time. Pages default to 50 and allow at most 100 rows with deterministic ordering and null due dates last. Counts use the same authorized query scope, counting top-level tasks separately from checklist subtasks. The Team filter applies to My/All, not the independent Assignments contact-coverage view; foreign or unavailable teams reveal no names or rows. Filter changes preserve sibling filters and reset pagination. Concurrent deletion either permits coherent continuation or an explicit reset, without silent skips, duplicates or leaks. Pagination representation follows Everyfield patterns.

title: Create, edit and delete tasks
behavior: Full/quick task retains trimmed nonempty bounded title, safe description, state/priority/category, optional LocalDate/time, current same plant assignee, person/meeting/team relation, parent, recurrence and prerequisites. Reject facility relation and malformed/mismatched relation pair; explicit null clears. Generated obligation/evaluation relation/source identity is protected from ordinary edit. Validate current task, graph, series and related subjects; concurrent edits must preserve their invariants; edit+status+prerequisites/history and recorded outcome/intent commit all or none, with no failed response after hidden title change. Soft-delete parent+children coherently; generated obligation/history persists. Parent deletion reviews consequences and cancels live reminders without erasing already performed evidence.

title: Complete and reopen tasks under own-duty authority
behavior: Recheck actual assignee/current authority at execution; Member completes/reopens only own duty, Owner/Admin any current same plant task. Completion records when and by whom, with status history and any successor or outcome, together. Repeating the same request shows the earlier result and adds no history. Reopen clears current completion projection but retains prior history and recomputes current metrics/contact evidence where affected; it does not forge past success or unsend delivery. Recurring older occurrence reopen fails if another open successor exists and names it. Parent completion remains explicit human judgment. Person linked administrative completion never implies contact.

title: Close a task as no longer needed
behavior: Retain no_longer_needed as closure distinct from complete. It suppresses open/overdue/due notices and actionable follow-up warnings but earns no successful task/48 h/contact credit. Generated immutable obligation records waiver permanently; edit/soft delete/replay/legacy fallback cannot regenerate waived task. Explicit reopen/correction with current state changes current state while preserving waiver history and one active obligation task. No bulk complete implicitly converts waiver into success.

title: One-level subtasks and checklists
behavior: One parent level only: deny nesting/self parent/cycles and turning task with children into child. New child inherits the parent assignee when omitted. Owner/Admin may explicitly choose a currently valid same-plant assignee or null; a Member may create only under their own currently assigned parent and inherits their own assignment, with no other-account or null override. Tick/untick/reopen uses the actual child assignee for Member own-duty. Child tasks have no deadline, recurrence, obligation, completion automation or contact hook; inert template definitions create real child Tasks, and a checklist item's completion is the child task's own status. Subsequent parent edit previews intended child assignment changes rather than silently moving others. Child tick/untick has own completion history/current own-duty policy; parent never auto completes. Parent delete soft deletes children with history. Recurrent successor copy resets every checklist item, clears child due dates and completion facts, and copies no contact/outcome hooks.

title: Task prerequisites and derived blocking
behavior: Top-level same-tenant tasks have unique prerequisite relationships. Deny self, foreign and deleted candidates. Cycles are forbidden, including when concurrent opposite relationships are proposed. Show derived blocked badge for unfinished actionable prerequisite, distinct from manual blocked status; Complete, no_longer_needed, or an existing prerequisite soft-deleted after the edge was saved releases derived blocking. Deletion supplies no successful-completion/48-hour/contact credit and preserves the predecessor and edge history. Badge is advisory and does not prevent explicit allowed completion. Current/history edge correction is audited and retry-safe; no generalized project work flow engine.

title: Recurring tasks and fresh successor checklists
behavior: Daily/weekly/biweekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly rules keep their interval, inclusive end date and optional local time. Completion creates exactly one successor by one interval from current due LocalDate, or completion LocalDate when undated, clamping month/year end. Late completion intentionally may produce already overdue successor; no skip-ahead/backfill service calendar. Completing a recurring task creates exactly one next task with a fresh checklist, history and reminders, even on retry; failure does not require user reopen/recomplete. Stop recurrence preserves history; older reopen refuses open-successor collision. Zone edit previews future wall recurrence and resolver applies once; inherited due LocalDate remains explicit.

title: Bulk completion and rescheduling
behavior: Bulk complete or reschedule of up to 100 tasks reports each task's result: success, no change, missing, deleted, foreign, closed, unauthorized, outdated or conflict, and what remains. A task that changed since review is refused, not overwritten. No generic failure hides finished tasks. Own-duty bulk complete rechecks the assignee for each task; admin reschedule cannot invent due dates on unselected tasks. A retry never repeats a finished change, a completed recurrence cannot duplicate, and one bad task does not claim whole batch success.

title: Browse, preview and import task templates
behavior: Keep canonical phase/category template keys, descriptions, priorities and relative LocalDate offsets through immutable versioned reference. Preview exact selected count and normalized safe markdown; import ordinary top-level tasks assigned current importer unless explicit reviewed eligible assignee. Reviewed operation ID makes transport retry idempotent; deliberate new import ID intentionally creates another set. Existing task text/dates never change from reference update. Reject stale version/invalid keys whole import; no source-row count substitute for reference content fidelity.

title: Review a phase-transition task offer
behavior: Latest unanswered actual transition ID offers current phase valid templates; phase event alone creates no tasks. Human may decline or accept any explicit valid subset, which answers that transition. Allow only one answer to each transition; selected tasks+answer/history and recorded outcome commit atomically, anchored to actual transition LocalDate. Stale transition/forged keys/authority refuses zero effects. Concurrent devices one winner; response loss returns durable actual inserted IDs, not temporary cookie-only receipt. Optional atomic bounded import failure leaves offer unanswered; no hidden partial claim strands selected templates.

title: Vision follow-ups and managed evaluation tasks
behavior: Use REQ-TSK-017 and REQ-MTG-020/021 for first-Vision obligation and managed-evaluation task production. Capture exact origin/Person/key and resolved 48 hstart; due LocalDate +2 separate. Manual follow-ups and distinct same-day meetings keep distinct identities. Missing eligible assignee is visible Needs owner. Protected source and persistent waiver prevent edit/delete/replay regeneration. Completion metric and contact freshness remain separate, correction history retained.

title: Follow-up assignments and unowned contacts
behavior: Eligible owner is actual account linked live same plant committed stage Person(core_group/launch_team/leader) with current seat; shared email/unlinked contact cannot own. Current demotion/access loss resolves stale assignee Needs owner even if stored ID remains. Assignment validates current eligibility at execution, derived labels from stored Person not client name. Manual create+assign may remain undated and has distinct manual origin; no invented due date or 48 h lineage invented. Assignment view shows actionable open tasks, grouped current owners, uncovered contact coverage without claiming urgent task when no explicit duty exists. No lead title-based authorization.

title: Follow-up handoff after authority loss
behavior: Preview the departing or demoted account's open follow-ups and the currently eligible recipients. An admin reviews them and moves them to an eligible person or leaves them as Needs owner. The result names what moved and what remains. Declining changes nothing, and every unresolved duty stays visible as Needs owner. A foreign or ineligible recipient, an outdated selection or the protected Owner exception is refused before anything moves. Closed, waived or deleted tasks never reopen. Account, person and former duty history remain.

title: Task due and overdue notifications
behavior: Schedule a due notice and the defined overdue notice from REQ-TSK-018; skip settled, deleted, unassigned and undated tasks. Each due and overdue reminder reaches the current assignee at most once. Completing, deleting, reassigning or rescheduling stops the old reminder; a stale reminder never reaches a former owner. A failed send is retried or reconciled, and a scheduled reminder is never reported as delivered.

title: Durable task status history
behavior: A task shows every status change with who or what made it and when, including creation, close, reopen and waiver, whether it came from a person, Evry, a bulk change, a generated evaluation, recurrence or a correction. A repeated request adds no entry. Reading history requires current task scope; a deleted task keeps its history where allowed, and a system trigger is never shown as a person. Shared audit is not universal public browser/export or retention exemption.

title: Task description Markdown
behavior: Create/edit/template paths normalize bounded≤50000 character description with explicit empty clear. Preserve plain-text paragraphs/newlines/meaning and safe markdown; sanitizer rejects/removes dangerous HTML/script/URL schemes. Preview snippet derives from same canonical text as full render and contains no executable markup. Use shared client-safe contract types without importing database runtime into UI. Description content is data, never agent/tool instructions.

title: Ministry teams and staffing
behavior: Retain custom/predefined teams with name, description, icon, forming/active/paused states, current leader and staffing counts. Stable templateKey survives rename; name is never template identity. Tenant-scoped lists and team tabs use live membership rather than drifting filled flags. Paused differs from archived. Custom setup and empty states remain usable without accepting a template. Current read-only role receives no mutation controls; server policy remains authoritative.

title: Archive, restore and correct teams
behavior: Archive hides a team from operational selectors, current staffing/health and default chart/list while retaining team/role/membership/training/meeting history. Explicit archived inclusion permits discovery and authorized restoration. Historical Person tabs show labelled former/archive records. Current follow-up duties remain visible; archiving does not waive them or broaden team programs to churchwide. Archive, restore and edit record who did it and why and mark affected assessments out of date. Repeating the same change does nothing. Restoration does not restore revoked seats or rewrite old tenure.

title: Initialize predefined teams and roles
behavior: Retain ten predefined ministry templates and separately selected role catalog through the versioned immutable reference manifest. Preview independently chosen ministries and roles, exact rows and editable destination choices. Skip/cancel/no selection and all reads create zero structure. Permit later additional selected roles after partial/custom setup; custom same name is never auto-conflated. Unique tenant/templateKey prevents renamed-template duplicates. Reviewed import validates every key/version/authority, creates selected teams/roles/responsibilities and receipt together or explicitly resumes named missing rows under one intent; response loss/retry/concurrent winner never duplicates. Existing customization/occupied leadership survives. Disclosed eligible Owner lead/Senior Pastor assignment uses ordinary selected vacant role only, with no entire automatic template import.

title: Appoint and synchronize team leaders
behavior: Store leader provenance explicit/role-derived/legacy without fabricated history. Explicit appointment outranks role-derived fallback and survives removing that role; fallback only fills an empty leader. Unlinked live contact may be a visible ministry leader but gains no account grant. Linked account must have current same plant seat to receive own-team actions. Seat revocation clears access-dependent appointment without erasing prior provenance. Candidate search is database-backed beyond the first 100 People. Concurrent assignment, vacancy, retirement and access removal preserve valid leadership and membership, with attributable history and assessment freshness updated atomically.

title: Team roles and template import
behavior: Role data includes trimmed name, leadership flag, nullable description/time commitment/desired skills, sort order and open/filled projection from active membership. One slot accepts one active Person; roles are not person counts. Preserve create/edit/import and deliberately delete from current structure through retirement, retaining old membership/assignment history rather than source cascade loss. Preview occupied-role consequences and explicit leader fallback. Dormant reporting fields do not enable a hierarchy editor; if retained for integrity, same-tenant references clear safely without changing fixed chart semantics.

title: Membership, role occupancy and tenure history
behavior: Validate current Person/team/role within tenant and atomically maintain one active occupant/role, slot fill, leader fallback, conditional People progression and history. Competing assignees have one winner and named occupied refusal; duplicate same-assignee retry is distinct from conflicting other occupant. Start/end LocalDate values and actor are preserved; reactivation creates a new tenure episode rather than rewriting prior dates. Person may hold several roles/teams; 2+teams yields an advisory warning, no hard maximum. Removal does not automatically demote People, withdraw commitment, erase earned training or alter account seat. Schema-only pending state has no new self-service work flow.

title: Team responsibilities
behavior: Preserve custom/predefined responsibility CRUD and tick/untick. Versioned structured Playbook lines are offered explicitly once during setup or later deliberate acceptance; reads/preview have no writes. The accepted/declined offer stamp, selected rows, receipt and audit commit together. Deleted/edited/declined lines never reappear on reload/bootstrap or upstream update. Complete has one current state/date with history and no implied phase pass. Foreign keys/selections and changed reviewed state refuse all effects.

title: Training programs, assignments and completion
behavior: Retain team-scoped and explicitly churchwide programs, required/optional flag and dated human verified completion. Team-leader actions require its own program and current eligible member/explicit saved assignment; churchwide actions require Owner/Admin. Apply REQ-TEAM-016 for required assignments/denominator. Distinct Person/program/version earned completion cannot duplicate via repeated roles; former earned evidence remains visible after team exit. Team retirement/deletion preserves program scope and history; nulling team must never silently convert it to churchwide. Completion is human evidence, independent from scheduling a session or assignment.

title: Correct, revoke and redo training
behavior: Reviewed-state program correction retains before/after actor/version. Completion revoke marks current evidence invalid without deletion; redo appends a new earned event/date/verifier and retains original/revoked/corrected evidence, never silently overwrites history. Reject repeated invalid transition or return original retry outcome. All current training/health/PI queries exclude revoked evidence and respect requirement-version compatibility. Revocation/correction/redo makes affected assessments stale with history atomically; assignment episodes stay separate.

title: Person team assignments and training
behavior: Person views show distinct current team assignments, multiple-role detail, dated former tenure and earned/revoked training independently of current applicability. Archived/retired teams are labelled historical and excluded from current counts; earned completion is not erased. Candidate selection/search is bounded and database-backed, including Person 101. Links recheck exact current Person/team permission and do not grant account authority.

title: Team and aggregate staffing health
behavior: Staffing measures occupied configured slots/slots; team attendance uses distinct actually attended relevant members against preserved historical distinct-member roster, not repeated-role rows or extra guests, over last 4 completed team meetings. Required training uses REQ-TEAM-016. Composite retains 40/35/25% staffing/training/attendance; absent required input means Unknown with no available-component reweighting. Measured zero differs from missing/not-applicable; empty configuration is not 100%. Staffing<40 red,<60 yellow and attendance<50 yellow remain. Exclude archived/inactive/pending from current operational measures while retaining dated historical basis and paused distinction; aggregate reports measured-team denominator. On-demand query, no invented weekly health job/leader alert or phase gate.

title: Organization chart from team hierarchy
behavior: Preserve all-team and single-team responsive chart, pan, visible leaders/roles/vacancies and identical legible SVG/PDF exports, with long/unbroken-name wrapping in shared drawing model. Leadership template is the fixed root, other teams children; labels say organization view, not formal reporting hierarchy. Current default excludes archived with explicit labelled inclusion option. Tenant DTO excludes raw contact/account/storage IDs and unsafe markup; exports reauthorize current scope. Dormant reports To data does not create hierarchy editing.

title: Team meetings and training sessions
behavior: Use the shared meeting type team_meeting with subtypes regular/training/planning/special/rehearsal, location/date/notes/status and one deduplicated active Person roster snapshot. Global list and team tab project the same meeting ID. Current own-team linked leader can schedule and record its team's attendance only; broader guest/RSVP/card/delete administration remains Owner/Admin. Later roster changes offer explicit reconciliation rather than mutate snapshot. Session scheduling emits a recorded fact, no nonexistent calendar integration/task generation or automatic training credit.

title: Team assignment consequences
behavior: Active role assignment advances only core_group→launch_team; qualifying ordinary ministry leadership advances only launch_team→leader. Required People history and plant source state commit with membership/leader mutation and original actor; repeat/no-op produces no duplicate semantic event. Removal never demotes automatically. Staffing/program/assignment corrections make affected assessments stale. Communication Hub owns actual team sends; emitted staffing/training_scheduled placeholders do not claim welcome mail, calendar, weekly alert or task delivery.

title: Communication hub, filtered history and delivery overview
behavior: Hub/history filters subject and safe body substring, linked context, lifecycle and reachable email channel; bounded page/limit ≤100 and safe fallback for invalid read filters. Available filters reflect all authorized history. Totals distinguish selected, reachable, attempted, accepted, delivered, engaged, failed and unknown; zero denominator is safe. Load failure shows unavailable.

title: Message detail, recipient and person/meeting communication histories
behavior: Detail and Person/meeting histories require same-plant parent and child constraints. Show the frozen delivery-time subject/address/body facts and separately label current contact/context facts. Recipient outcomes/timestamps stay attributable. Deleted/gone parent yields not found.

title: Compose and preview sanitized rich-text email with merge fields
behavior: Compose/preview subject 1–500 characters, nonempty safe rendered body and at least one reachable reviewed recipient for sending. Sanitize stored HTML and derive plain text from it; merge Person/plant/meeting fields using the same renderer for preview and dispatch. Reject malformed JSON and foreign template/meeting IDs before persistence. No SMS/both dispatch.

title: Recipient search and closed quick-select groups
behavior: Search first 20 results; closed groups core_group/launch_team/leaders/prospects/all and active/forming team IDs resolve the whole group, deduplicate Person IDs and show missing-email exclusions. Unknown selector resolves zero. Recruitment groups exclude account-seat cohort as specified by People. Re-resolve at review/handoff rather than truncate to search pagination.

title: Bulk provider dispatch and per-recipient outcome correlation
behavior: Dispatch exact frozen per-recipient payloads with one truthful delivery history; correlate ordered batches of at most 100 by intent ID, apply suppression/current handoff checks, and retain accepted/rejected/unknown facts separately. A short result array or exception never marks all recipients sent. Unknown acceptance reconciles with the same frozen provider key within its retention window and blocks blind new-key replay afterward.

behavior: Compose and resend return confirmed zero-provider-acceptance as failure with saved communication ID and sentAt null; partial results show exact accepted/rejected/unknown counts. An all-unknown result is uncertain rather than success, and missing provider IDs remain reconcilable.

behavior: Browse global system and same-plant templates. Owner/Admin communication writers create/update same-plant email templates and fork global templates once per plant/source identity. Name 1–255, description ≤1000, subject ≤500, nonempty sanitized body; unchanged reviewed state on edit. System originals are immutable to plant writers. Archive referenced templates; delete an unreferenced fork may reveal current global source.

behavior: Seven approved system message templates have stable source/revision IDs and category/meeting-type mapping. Fork preference is by source identity. Bootstrap repeat-equal is no-op; mismatch never overwrites a plant customization. Installation uses reference release.

behavior: Resend proposal requires sent original, ≥24 elapsed hours, ≥1 confirmed delivery and currently deliverable delivered non-openers. Click/open exclude; missing/deleted/suppressed recipients exclude. Present unreliable tracking caveat and exact exclusions. New communication retains frozen original delivery content and lineage; review current permitted recipient substitutions rather than silently remerge. Original remains unchanged.

title: Public token RSVP and email engagement linkage
behavior: Random purpose-bound public RSVP token is scoped to one real same-plant Person/meeting, normally expires after seven days and has one live pending identity per pair. GET displays, explicit POST confirms/declines. The answer and canonical meeting response succeed or fail together; scanner fetch never answers. Expired pending renewal preserves answered history. Token answer affects RSVP/engagement, never attendance/commitment/contact.
