behavior: Implement REQ-MTG-022. Replace source inference from every completed person linked task with typed human-confirmed outcome and actual occurredAt. Preserve Person/contact log/read history and task/meeting links; completed administrative task or attempt gets its own label, never delivered email/confirmed contact. Correction/reopen/void recomputes current freshness without removing history or resending effects. Communication owns log read projection; follow-up owns outcome writer and People/PI consume the same effective contact fact.

behavior: Save/reload/edit/delete incomplete native email drafts in the existing communication aggregate with conflict detection/history and no mail intent. Review exact audience/per-recipient safe content/Instant before Resend API scheduling within 30 days. Reviewed time-only update preserves content; content/audience replacement waits for confirmed cancellation of all affected original sends. Sent/unknown/partial cancellation blocks automatic replacement. SMS/inbound/custom beyond-window scheduling are excluded.

title: Tenant/organization anchored enqueue and deduplicated delivery intent
behavior: Typed plant or exact organization anchor, recipient and paired entity identity; one live occurrence key, renewed occurrence after cancellation only when legitimate. Commit only currently eligible category/audience. No generic unchecked organization UUID.

title: Atomic channel dispatcher, batching, backoff and live-subject cancellation
behavior: Due claim, generation fence, timeout/backoff, cancellation, unknown reconciliation follow execution; fairness tuning belongs to G-LOAD; mail preserves one truthful delivery history. Recipient, current preference, live subject/entity and sharing are rechecked at dispatch.

behavior: Self feed/unread/bell show only due visible uncanceled entries under current grants; deterministic bounded pagination, unread filter, individual mark and mark-all-visible use identical predicates. Future/foreign/revoked entries and their counts are hidden. Read does not complete work. Empty differs from unavailable.

title: User category/channel preferences with explicit-choice intent
behavior: Own category/channel explicit choices, planter cadence/local schedule and organization oversight cadence use small closed inputs and unchanged reviewed state. Only actual producers appear as enabled functionality. No custom rules, arbitrary schedules, snooze or alert families.

title: Task due/overdue reminders and reminder cancellation/resync
behavior: Each due and one-calendar-day overdue reminder reaches the current assignee at most once. Completing, deleting, reassigning or rescheduling stops the old reminder; a stale reminder never reaches a former owner.

title: Meeting scheduled and day-offset reminders
behavior: Scheduled meeting announcement to linked eligible core-group accounts; 7/3/1 day-offset reminders to eligible linked attendance/guest-list accounts plus creator. Edit cancels/rebuilds; canceled/completed/past meetings suppress obsolete reminders. CRM bulk guest invitations use Communication, not another address fallback.

title: Planter open-items daily/weekly digest and church local send schedule
behavior: Nonempty authorized planter open-items digest contains overdue/due-before-next-period tasks and upcoming meetings. Current assignee scope and church-local period determine count; one logical recipient period. Catch-up consolidates current items and real dates.

title: Oversight privacy-preserving daily activity digest
behavior: Exact organization oversight digest contains permitted activity counts and dates, no names/notes/message bodies/giving. Period uses the organization's saved IANA zone, default UTC when absent, displayed in preferences. Current approved relationship plus activity sharing gates each plant contribution at compile and dispatch. Two affiliates never share permission state. Empty activity sends nothing.

title: Relationship, sharing, phase and launch milestone fanout
behavior: Existing relationship/sharing facts and actual phase advance/launch milestones fan out once per occurrence. Declaration/backward phase movement is not advance. Relationship-ending notice can state its own committed event to the affected plant without reopening departed private data. Ordinary current Owner/Admin eligible notice audiences replace title-derived authority.

title: Signed delivery webhooks for notifications and bulk communication
behavior: Verify signed raw-body provider event before lookup, persist unique event ID and processing state before 2xx, retry non 2xx on storage failure, and apply out-of-order facts idempotently without regression. Unknown provider IDs are durably available for reconciliation; no public tenant selector. Soft bounce differs from hard/complaint, whose address suppression remains global.

title: Global address suppression and self-service restoration history
behavior: Normalize addresses and keep one active hard-bounce/complaint suppression with attributed restoration history. Fresh authenticated self-address proof plus reason and exact review can clear only the current account address. Dispatch uses suppression across all shared mail purposes; clearing cannot resurrect canceled mail or grant another address.

title: Category email unsubscribe, one-click opt-out and bounded undo
behavior: Category email opt-out leaves in-app untouched. Purpose-bound authenticated-encryption token: disable 180 days, separate undo one hour. GET confirms; explicit POST changes. Wrong/expired purpose fails closed; provider one-click POST uses RFC8058. Versioned key ring retains decrypt-only old keys through valid token lifetime; dedicated production key never cron-secret fallback. Opt-out does not invent CRM marketing consent.

title: Protected security and invitation mail
behavior: Protected transactional HTML/plain-text templates use recoverable delivery with bounded timeout/idempotency/outcome reconciliation. Domain issuer fixes purpose/address/token, not arbitrary Evry inputs. Security/invitation purposes are separate from optional preference toggles; credentials/tokens/body/address stay out of logs/context.

title: Declared notification producers and unused email helpers
behavior: Published global change behind organization customization produces an in-app-only notice to current own-org Owner/Admin editors. Email preferences cannot enable email for this notice. Every published upstream change, including typo-only, qualifies; it never adopts/overwrites/hides/unhides or forces a deadline. Unused team welcome/health/training/communication/assessment-ready helpers remain excluded as producers.

behavior: Winning Discovery association acceptance/decline/departure/removal occurrence creates transactional-purpose receipts to the Discovery account and valid owners of that exact organization, deduplicated by recipient. Seatless account needs no phantom plant/inbox. Admin title alone does not add a receipt recipient. Commit association/history first with required durable mail intent; rendering/refusal does not undo the association.

behavior: Filterable/contextual library of 11 templates and 12 offered template-format combinations; commitment/vision_meeting/administrative/operational categories, phase and curated Wiki/meeting/team mappings. Unknown retired mapping omits link.

Exact PDF bytes and structural DOCX/XLSX preview preserve offered formats, formulas/footer/content with artifact≤8MiB/XML≤2 million chars/1000 blocks/XLSX 20 sheets 500 rows 50 cols. behavior: Render current eligible published tutorial/how-to/explanation/reference/overview/guide content; no foreign body. behavior: Phase/sidebar Getting-started, Journey 0–6, frameworks/reference/resources; deterministic order/title/slug; H2/H3 TOC, breadcrumbs, accessible mobile drawer, same-parent siblings and eligible related IDs. Missing/duplicate references skip safely; non-ASCII/spaces/path delimiters have one encoding contract.

behavior: English weighted Postgres full-text title/excerpt/content, bounded web-search query ≤200 characters, phase filter and 20/page. Safe highlight snippets; results/empty/unavailable distinct. Authenticated search actions never use crawler allowance. Source view uses the exact same resolver.

behavior: Per-reader not-started/in-progress/completed history, actual progress/resume/recent and visible-corpus statistics. Validate actual currently accessible article/source/version, not only well-formed slug. Passive reopen updates viewed time, never fabricated completion or downgrade. Reading identity follows canonical article with attributed source/revision evidence.

behavior: Own explicit desired bookmark state, unique(reader, canonical article), idempotent set/unset and current visible-source resolution. Hidden/foreign/departed entries do not leak body/count through list.

behavior: Own helpful/unhelpful vote under current plant/article/source scope; closed input and conflict detection and no-op semantics. Account-private Discovery reading does not manufacture a church vote. No new admin analysis surface.

behavior: Print/PDF uses the exact currently rendered entitled body, structured paragraphs/headings/lists/tables/callouts, local fonts, safe filename/source/footer. Failure offers print fallback; no saved generated-document record or assumed embedded-widget export.

title: Contextual WikiGuide operational reference panel
behavior: Contextual route/wildcard WikiGuide returns current authorized excerpt/reference with source/version citation; missing/unauthenticated/gone/unavailable are distinct. Fetch alone does not write reading progress. Guide text cannot instruct Evry to execute.

title: Secret-gated content-cache refresh and retired admin mutations
behavior: Scoped publication/cache refresh uses authenticated operator/editor operations, typed source/version and bounded invalidation. Unset secret/operator authority refuses. Cache slug escaping differs from URL escaping only through one tested contract. No retired unscoped editor mutations.

behavior: Approved starter and later global reference installation, reproducible manifest/derivatives, repeat-equal no-op and atomic activation are governed by reference release. Never copy unversioned stored embeddings.

behavior: Sessionless global published Wiki metadata/article previews for supported social/search fetcher classifications only on exact /wiki paths. Public preview is deliberately public even if UA is spoofed; it carries no plant/personal shell or data. Human WhatsApp WebView, unknown UA/path, /wikileaks, action requests, private routes and invalid sessions retain normal auth. Trusted actual route metadata replaces client routing headers.

title: Feedback dialog with private page and device details
behavior: The authenticated feedback dialog collects category, description, page, address, church, role, browser, screen size, theme, app version and time, with no screenshot or attachment. Category is bug, suggestion, question or other; trim description to 1–5,000 characters. Page is the displayed page label; address is its internal path with query, fragment and tokens removed, not a postal address or arbitrary external URL. Bind church and role to trusted current account context; keep unavailable details null rather than inventing values. Store the private original, immutable original author, trusted submission time and occurrence/idempotency key before outward work. Church, role, browser, screen size, theme and app version stay in the private original and never appear in a public issue, including reviewed richer text. Native own list/status uses the original authenticated active account and a bounded 25-row cursor projection, without private originals, admin joins or another author. Stored success is distinct from publication, triage or implementation; suspended/deleted authors are denied.

title: Platform-wide feedback triage and status transitions
behavior: Explicit immutable platform-principal grant, separate from plant/org roles, permits bounded private triage filter/list and new/reviewed/resolved/dismissed status changes with unchanged reviewed state/actual actor/history/no-op receipt. Unknown row refuses and stale edit conflicts. Public issue closure remains external observed fact, not proof of implementation/PR/deployment.

title: Automatic safe public feedback issues and private operator mail
behavior: Safe automatic feedback issue/triage uses separate PUBLIC repo with private original, frozen sanitized payload/hash/opaque occurrence and durable actual repoID/owner-name snapshot/issueID-number/URL.10 second external timeout enters unknown and reconciles same marker in exact destination before retry; inaccessible/ambiguous remains held. Deterministic closed serializer never copies raw private text/IDs/URL/logs, richer publication exact-reviewed; actual merged owner workflow governs routing, no competing rubric/coding authority.

title: Dashboard routing by identity and onboarding/plant state
behavior: Home routing uses validated current account/seat/active subject and persisted onboarding facts: account-private Discovery/no plant, organization oversight, incomplete setup/resume or plant dashboard. Query parameters/browser dismissals cannot certify setup or bypass server predicates. Creation Phase 1 is independent of Discovery completion.

title: Plant metrics, activity feed, quick actions and operational prompts
behavior: Plant dashboard retains four independent metrics: recruited core_group/launch_team/leader excluding account-seat cohort; all nondeleted People; viewer-assigned overdue Tasks; completed Vision Meetings. Bounded 20-event feed uses actual source occurrence/correction history and per-item owning read projection. Quick actions require current write capability. Phase header uses actual saved phase; launch card uses canonical planned/status/countdown/readiness and recorded actual outcomes, without treating UI counters as rubric thresholds. Scoped dismissal state can hide optional prompts, never change evidence. No plant-private activity feed is an oversight substitute.

title: Early access site and one access-request form
behavior: The public early access site serves home, oversight, access, privacy and terms. Examples are static synthetic illustrations with claims matching the actual target. Only live pages appear in navigation, sitemap and robots; planters/trust pages and product sign-in links wait for WP-049. Initial reviewed privacy copy names Vercel, Neon and Resend, collection purpose, retention and how to ask for deletion. One public access form asks whether the visitor is a church planter, a sending church or a sending network, then submits one of two request kinds with the declared fields and trimmed, normalized email: a church planter submits a planter request; a sending church or network submits a network request. The church or network choice changes labels only and is not stored. The planter request requires name, email, plant_name, city and phase; sending is optional. The network request requires name, email, organization and role; plants and message are optional. The plants field accepts an empty value or up to four decimal digits and stores a supplied count as a number. Optional empty text is omitted. The approved phase choices are 0 · Discovery, 1 · Core group, 2 · Launch team, 3 · Training, 4 · Pre-launch, 5 · Launch Sunday and 6 · Post-launch. A filled website honeypot returns received before field validation without a request, attempt or mail. Invalid fields return invalid with field errors and create no effects. Mail configuration, including the recipient, must be usable before admission. Admission permits five valid attempts per normalized email in a rolling 24-hour window and twenty per IP in a rolling hour. Admitted duplicates and pending retries count as attempts. An unavailable trusted IP uses a shared unknown-IP budget rather than bypassing that axis. Rate limits are checked before duplicate suppression or retry; email is the reason when both limits apply. A refusal stores no request or attempt and sends no mail. An admitted submission stores one early access request with the validated fields and original owner-mail payload. Only an earlier request with a recorded mail receipt suppresses a duplicate within 24 hours for the same normalized email and kind, returning received without another request or email. Provider rejection, timeout, missing provider receipt or failure to save that receipt returns unavailable and leaves the stored request pending. Pending means both mail receipt fields are empty; a stored receipt supplies the provider mail ID and mail time. A pending retry less than 23 elapsed hours old reuses the same row, original payload and provider idempotency key, and returns received only after the mail receipt is saved. At exactly 23 elapsed hours or later, an admitted submission creates a new request with a new provider key and the newly submitted fields; the old pending row remains for retention. A second owner email is acceptable if the earlier delivery was unresolved. Rate limits still apply before this new request. Concurrent callers may repeat HTTP delivery attempts with that same key and payload, but the provider sends one email. Storage or mail failure returns unavailable; the visitor sees the contact fallback and no false success. Operator CSV export is a private command requiring database credentials, with no public export endpoint. It includes every retained request ordered by creation instant and ID, all submitted fields and mail receipt fields. The header has sixteen columns: id, created_at, kind, name, email, plant_name, city, phase, sending, organization, role, plants, message, ip_address, mail_id, mailed_at. Every data cell is quoted, embedded quotes are doubled, rows use CRLF and cells beginning with optional whitespace then =, +, @ or - are prefixed with an apostrophe to prevent spreadsheet formulas. A file export creates a new private file with mode 0600 and refuses to overwrite an existing file. The restricted scheduled job deletes requests strictly older than 12 calendar months, clears stored IP addresses strictly older than 30 days, and deletes limiter attempts strictly older than 24 hours. Exact cutoff rows are retained; a twelve-month boundary request can still have its older IP cleared. No account, CRM record, newsletter or double opt-in is created. The result uses status received, invalid with `fieldErrors`, rate_limited with reason email or ip, or unavailable. Field error codes are required, email, number and too_long. Retention reports `deleted` and `clearedIps`.

title: Public privacy/terms, static sitemap and robots
behavior: Public privacy/terms and static sitemap/robots preserve public access; robots is not auth. Before real data, reviewed copy names actual selected vendors, model purpose/terms, immediate normal-access suspension, 30-day private cancellation hold, eligible live purge, ≤7 further days of recovery copies from completed live purge, minimal retained shared attribution and asynchronous/external-copy limits. title: External schedules and bounded HTTP job ticks
behavior: Background execution is authenticated, bounded, durable and recoverable under the execution contract. Worker replacement, cancellation and stale input cannot publish or duplicate work. Unknown provider outcomes require reconciliation. G-LOAD owns measured fairness and alert tuning. Schedule invocation supplies no business authority, and actual deployment schedule and limits require configuration proof. Execution mechanisms follow Everyfield patterns.

title: Basic health and runtime errors versus dependency readiness
behavior: Public liveness returns only bounded process status/time. Privileged readiness distinguishes DB/object/mail/callback backlog/job lag/reference/backup readiness with safe error correlation. Dependency failure cannot be a fake empty result. No sensitive details/token/address/body in public error or health.

behavior: Optional configured Sentry and isolated Langfuse/OTel retain content-free latency/token/status/build/run correlation. Validate explicit HTTPS endpoint except loopback, no embedded credentials/query/hash/public secrets; no implicit tracing-provider fallback. Bounded flush/telemetry outage cannot change domain result. Private-care body/existence/calendar/nudge metadata, credentials/mail body/addresses/model prompts/file bytes are excluded.

title: Atomic domain consequences and durable advisory intents
behavior: Required cross-domain consequences succeed or fail together. Attendance, follow-up obligations, tasks, audit and reported outcomes remain consistent after failure, retry and concurrent changes. Optional background effects remain recoverable after interruption and do not duplicate completed work. Each consumer applies current subject and scope authority. No public arbitrary-event executor is exposed.

title: Migration generation, journal provenance and safe operator diagnostics
behavior: Fresh versioned migration history/checksums and approved reference bootstrap; positively identified owned DB target, safe concurrent execution and replay provenance. Preserve applied history and refuse conflicting checksum/unknown target. No db:push, legacy-chain requirement, live ledger patching or customer migration. Recovery uses recovery.

behavior: Separate immutable approved references from synthetic demo/evaluation fixtures. Seed/reset only explicitly positively identified disposable owned environment with independent DB/storage/auth/mail/jobs and no copied production identities/credentials. Sentinel alone is insufficient. Repeat-equal bootstrap no-op and mismatches stop.

title: Isolated live database tests and hermetic build/CI checks
behavior: Hermetic build with frozen lockfile and placeholder secrets; meaningful contract/browser/API/native SQL race/failure suites require explicit isolated endpoint and registered real execution. Mock counts/text checks cannot certify behavioral acceptance. Before real data close actual DB+matching-byte restore and retention/expiry proof.

title: Managed local previews, disposable mail and worktree environment
behavior: Named managed preview records checkout/source revision/URL and isolated DB/storage/auth/provider destinations; no unrelated localhost evidence, dependency symlink or secret wholesale copy. Real mail/model/provider actions are disabled/stubbed unless separately authorized. Cleanup is scoped to that verified preview.

title: Issue board synchronization and agent workflow tooling
behavior: Requirement/case/issue traceability and optional engineering board integration only after merged owner workflow is received. Do not copy historical hardcoded private project/options/tokens or revive retired delivery gates. Live labels/status reread; missing integration visibly skips without product failure. Safe public intake/triage remains the accepted subset and does not wait for invented routing.

behavior: Read-only tool/script inventory classifies diagnostic versus mutation, identifies target/credentials/environment and records named native proof coverage. Hooks/proof tools are installed only for chosen supported workflow. Preserve semantic tests/reproducibility rather than every historic adapter. Inventory is not permission to execute a script.

behavior: Read-only source/retired-Evry diagnostics remain evidence. The new first-class Evry contract uses shared target domain operations; no legacy runtime/table restoration or assumption from a catalog probe. Existing v2 source/database remains untouched.

behavior: Build one deterministic immutable fact snapshot at a fixed run asOf from one consistent database source revision, pin formula/schema/provenance and represent unavailable inputs explicitly; no independent mixed-time reads.

behavior: Count each currently active explicitly classified adult once across supported commitments; genuine valid historical first acquisitions drive adjacent 28 day windows and 21/28 day timing independently of current size. Real withdrawal lowers size without erasing acquisition; rejoin/repeat/team move is not new. Correct invalid occurrence evidence through history; partial lower-bound size and timing certainty remain separate.

title: Growth source composition and unknown source counts
behavior: Expose recorded recruited-contact source composition with explicit unknown-source count and cohort lineage only to permitted planter audiences. No conversion inference or organization/cross-plant composition/ranking.

title: Vision meeting cadence, completed attendance and trend
behavior: Use actual completed Vision occurrences and completed distinct attendance for 14 day biweekly cadence, predictable rhythm, 21 watch/28 direct and last-two attendance trend; no scheduled-only substitute or weekly over meeting warning.

behavior: Derive cohesion from actual completed-meeting participation: absent last 28 days after prior 28 participation among active commitments, at least 20 percent and minimum three. Dated leader disengagement changes voice one level, never claims relational unity or qualification; missing evidence Unknown.

behavior: Measure eight stable methodology responsibility assignments separately from optional tenant teams, distinct people and Prayer Leader. Named agreed worship attestation or actual active assignment satisfies Phase 1 identification; all-eight Phase 2 uses actual assignments. No name-substring mapping, forced teams, ninth conjunction or automatic leader grants.

title: Leadership candidate signals and human interview/4Cs references
behavior: Sixty days of unbroken attendance AND volunteering needs dated records and/or dated person-scoped planter attestation for unobserved behavior. Human interview/4Cs are dated recorded judgments; tenure/lifetime totals do not prove continuity or qualification. Candidate identities are planter-only; suggested conversation never assigns/promotes. PI/Evry/model inputs exclude human Interview/FourCs scores, judgments, notes and qualification results; only operational evidence and recorded human-assessment presence/count/date can be projected.

title: Training program/member completion readings
behavior: Required training uses saved explicit distinct current person/program assignments; bulk expansion previews exact reviewed people, later memberships do not recompute roster. 100 percent applicable obligations completes; empty/missing applicability Unknown. Earned/revoked/corrected completion independent from assignment and historical rosters.

title: Launch countdown, status, milestones and outcome facts
behavior: Read current native launch planned/actual dates, status, local countdown, milestone validity, headcount and submitted debrief/guest cue as independent typed facts. Uncompleted final window 0–28 days; past target overdue until actual occurrence/reschedule/postpone, no automatic phase.

title: Legacy person-record follow-up staleness facts
behavior: Preserve historical follow-up proxy interpretation only under its exact old snapshot/formula version. Current profile updatedAt never supplies actual-contact freshness or completion; unknown true source is Unknown.

title: Measured task follow-up ownership
behavior: Count actual live follow-up task ownership, distinct eligible assignees/unowned/stale-unowned separately. Removed/ineligible owner is unowned; staleness or volume alone cannot blame the planter. This is a report.

title: 48-hour originating-meeting follow-up task metric
behavior: Measure successful originating-obligation task-completion Instant within 48 elapsed hours from actual originating meeting occurrence, separately from local+2 calendar-day due date and actual contact success. Waiver gets no success credit; manual/missing origin unmeasured. Phase 6 without approved postlaunch origin is Unknown; no Vision substitute. Use one fixed asOf and actual immutable originating occurrence Instant as source-start. Include mature unresolved obligations at age>=48 elapsed hours as measured misses and valid successful completion at/after source-start and by source-start+48 hours (inclusive), even before maturity. Exclude younger pending, future actual origin/effective creation or completion, completion before origin, and missing/invalid origin/completion from the ratio with exact truthful labels. Waived/no_longer_needed obligations are separately excluded, not failures. Soft-deleted genuine originating meetings retain immutable historical evidence. Actual occurrence/completion and recordedAt/database createdAt are distinct: legitimate later recording never invalidates valid backdated evidence. Legacy task-createdAt-start formulas remain labelled only in their original snapshot versions. This is a report.

title: Actual contact freshness independent of task completion
behavior: Actual effective contacted occurrence updates 14 day contact freshness; attempted/administrative completion/waiver/task status/profile edit/mail opens never prove contact. Missing/future date Unknown; correction retains history. This is a report.

title: Eight-lens measured/attested/unknown evidence profile
behavior: Each of eight lenses exposes measured/attested/unknown evidence, exact source age and independent subdimensions. Unknown never passes. Typed human assertions retain actor/question/reference/occurrence/recording/correction lineage and cannot originate from model or private care.

title: Seven manual attestation toggles and reaffirmation
behavior: Exactly seven legacy manual keys/questions with native current/history/correct/retract/reaffirm. Prayer rhythm, gatherings and giving each retain 30 day age/reaffirmation; stale answer never false/current by default. Funding, values, systems, Prayer Leader remain nonexpiring and independent.

title: Active and historical rubric version registry
behavior: Resolve immutable original plant rubric v0/v1 and original Playbook by exact packaged hash, with final SME comment dispositions authoritative over stale compiled wording. Current operational prompt adapter is separately versioned; no silent history or methodology rewrite.

title: Phase-filtered dense/sparse methodology retrieval
behavior: Retrieve phase-relevant permitted methodology from the complete activated dense/sparse corpus; pin passage/source/revision/hash and whole rubric outside embeddings. Current entitlement on retrieval and old citation reads; no invented citation or departed organization body.

title: Typed dual-audience judge and product-rule validation
behavior: Validate typed dual-audience judged draft before publication: exact facts/numbers/citations/concern pairing, safe allowed field projection, launch-progress scope, no church-health/character/pastoral verdict. Unknown and each attestation remain explicit.

title: Bounded corrective draft retries
behavior: Rejected output drafts use at most three bounded corrective drafts with accumulated actual violations under shared deadline/token budgets; exhaustion fails truthfully and retains previous complete result.

title: Provider throttling, backoff and learned token pacing
behavior: Provider retry at most four attempts per draft respects 429 Retry-After/headers, bounded 5xx/backoff/pacing and one deadline/token budget. Deferral/usage/attempt counters truthful; no paid call or account setting assumed by documentation. Every SDK/provider implicit retry setting is maxRetries=0; the one declared worker attempt budget owns every actual dispatch.

title: Dirty-or-seven-day-stale assessment scheduling
behavior: Select never-assessed, changed-source/reference and seven-day-stale subjects from durable SQL state with bounded scan/checkpoint recovery. Fairness tuning belongs to G-LOAD. Time refresh has independent daily-window demand identity even when source/rubric unchanged; no model generation on reads.

title: Pending/complete/failed/deferred snapshots and recovery
behavior: The assessment row carries demand identity, captured snapshot, attempt state and publication availability; job owns lease generation. Capture fixed facts before model work. Pending, deferred, failed or superseded attempts preserve prior valid complete results. Current reads derive the latest authorized complete assessment ordered by available_at and ID, without a separately mutable publication pointer. Claim expiry or reclaim never grants stale publication.

title: Insight persistence, severity/rank and snapshot deltas
behavior: Persist insights, overall durable summary, immutable complete metadata, snapshot deltas and assessment availability atomically after current source, reference, execution ownership and grant checks. Severity orders insights only; no plant ranking. Bus failure after commit cannot demote complete. Canonical model urgency positive|info|watch|urgent maps exactly to persisted info|low|medium|high respectively; critical is reserved and never produced by ordinary assessment mapping.

title: Cached assessment reads, as-of and seen marker
behavior: Read cached persisted assessments at zero model calls with exact asOf/reference/source/age/state; genuine eligible first-open marker governs opened-or-72-hour release. Phase difference remains visible rather than rebinding old snapshot standings.

title: Human-readable citations and exact snapshot drill-down
behavior: Resolve exact cited snapshot path/value/manual key and source passage hash; mismatch is visible/rejected at current publication, unknown path unverifiable. Display citations never grant underlying person/body access.

behavior: Render eight evidence-aware CSF lens standings with measured/attested/unknown, insufficient-evidence tiles and independent generosity/funding/prayer ages. Judge standing remains distinct from deterministic criterion measurement.

Current producer map and conjunction have no weights; Unknown blocks ready without failing. Phase 1>=30 known lower-bound alone never clears five-indicator cluster; Phase 6 terminal has no exit.

behavior: Read persisted historical trends and existing engine-derived alerts with original snapshot/source/formula versions and current permitted projections; correction affects current evidence, never overwrites past snapshots or adds new alert family.

title: Milestone timeline of declared/moved phases and launch
behavior: Timeline distinguishes actual creation Phase 1 with no prior phase, one existing-journey declaration, reasoned actual transitions and native launch history. No synthetic ladder/meeting/phase effects.

title: Oversight privacy-safe four-valued health rollup
behavior: Oversight resolves current exact-org health/category grants and released aggregate-safe results, independent directory access and four-valued rollup. Unshared is Limited visibility/Not shared, never On track or zero; no raw snapshots, individuals, private care or source composition.
