behavior: Same-concern identifier+evidence pairs plant and oversight observations. Eligible human opened OR 72 elapsed hours after durable availability releases; previous still-authorized result survives embargo. Permission revocation always wins, including NI/Location inputs.

title: Per-insight feedback rating and optional comment
behavior: Own authenticated currently authorized reader feedback binds exact insight/run/rubric, useful/not_useful and bounded optional comment with idempotency/history. No other-author overwrite, score/rubric/retraining effect; every Evry write exactly reviewed.

title: Cold-start queued/quiet guidance
behavior: Cold start shows genuine not_generated/queued/quiet/reference_not_ready states and useful deterministic next steps; no fabricated unmet criteria, empty-green assessment or model call while reading.

title: Judge observability and graceful optional tracing
behavior: Bounded observability records run/status/last-draft violations/usage/version IDs with optional tracing safely failing. No raw prompts/outputs/private canaries/protected manifests or private-care existence/calendar/nudges in broad telemetry.

title: Offline fleet evaluation, assessment requests and language audit
behavior: Offline reference/fleet language/numeric/privacy evaluation and bounded authorized operator triggers use synthetic permitted fixtures and exact pinned versions; future protocol/pass/fail declared, not falsely counted as runtime success or live account proof.

title: Assessment input freshness across every writer
behavior: Every committed change to assessment-relevant input makes affected assessments stale, across native, Evry, import, correction, merge, removal and system writers. WP-040 proves that all inputs actually used by the fact builder, including conditional inputs, participate in freshness checks. Failed changes, exact retries, real no-ops and unrelated fields do not create changed assessment evidence. Organization results reflect current affiliation, category sharing, contributor inputs and released source assessments. Current reference activation also governs publication. Missed wake-ups cannot lose refresh work. Private-care bodies, existence, calendars, corrections, nudges and support questions never affect assessment inputs or freshness. The implementation must preserve these outcomes without requiring a revision column, trigger set or caller helper.

title: Private weekly four-dimension planter check-in
behavior: Native current same-plant Owner/Admin and immutable original account author save/read their four exact private questions with Steady/Strained/Struggling and an optional note of at most 2,000 characters; no successor/title/admin inheritance, Evry/model/org/export/log/audit access.

title: Private 12-week strip and three-consecutive-struggling nudge
behavior: Native twelve week viewport is not retention. Three adjacent same author/same dimension logical Monday weeks of Strained OR Struggling raise private support question; Steady/missing breaks, old streak dated, no outreach/model/PI effect.

title: Full private check-in correction history
behavior: Own native full private history keeps stable original author+plant+week IDs, personal-zone starts/ordinals and all corrections; current eligibility required, no cross-author/CRM merge ownership substitution.

title: Correct existing check-in without deleting history
behavior: Correct only own existing private entry with unchanged reviewed state, old/new native history and idempotency. Personal zone edit keeps the open week until first strictly future Monday in the requested zone then one next ordinal; serialize rollover/edit/save and preserve missing weeks without duplicate credit.

title: Accurate final-draft assessment failure diagnostics
behavior: Failed assessment diagnostic reports actual final draft violation and distinct provider/output/persistence/deadline cause; completed result cannot be demoted after callback failure, no raw payload leakage.

title: One-time midjourney initial phase declaration
behavior: One attributed idempotent existing-journey initial declaration per plant is distinct from actual new plant creation Phase 1 entry. No synthesized prior phases; retry returns original. Owner/Admin current exact plant authority. Declared phase is a number/integer 0..6; no caller reason/kind. Server stores exact reserved initial-declaration sentence and kind, independent of creation.

title: Reasoned forward/backward/skipping/correcting phase transition
behavior: Reasoned forward/backward/skip/correct transition uses protected current phase+unchanged reviewed state and atomic journal/current phase/assessment freshness/audit and recorded outcome. Readiness never blocks or advances automatically. Target phase is a number/integer 0..6; reason is string trimmed 1..2000 and rejects exact reserved initial-declaration sentence after trim, including noop requests; declaration kind is unreachable here.

title: Direction classification and same-phase behavior
behavior: Classify actual transition direction; preserve same-phase noop journal/event receipt without material fact bump, duplicate replay or invented progress/task creation. Validate ordinary integer bounds and reason/reserved-string rule before creating any same-phase noop receipt.

title: Advisory ready/approaching/not_ready/unknown phase control
behavior: Advisory ready/approaching/not_ready/unknown follows current criterion conjunction and evidence; no single indicator/unknown silence clears phase cluster or moves phase.

title: Typed phase.changed and assessment.created events
behavior: Typed actual phase.changed and plant.assessment.created notices use transactionally required intents after durable result; privacy/current audience applies. Creation and same-phase events truthful, no fake progression.

title: Phase-driven task-template prompt and Wiki recommendations
behavior: Actual phase context offers existing task templates and relevant Wiki content under current entitlement; reads/offers create no tasks, acceptance reviewed and preserves declined/edited/deleted choices.

title: Phase transition audit and journey chronology
behavior: Read attributed current/historical phase journal and actual chronology with creation/initial declaration distinctions, unchanged reviewed state/concurrency and current permissions; no rewritten prior journey.

title: Seven church-planting phases and Playbook criteria catalog
behavior: Seven exact phases and 19 criterion identities are portable original reference plus direct current operational evidence map; no terminal Phase 6 exit or new pastoral/services scope.

title: Set, move, postpone and recommit canonical launch date
behavior: Current plant Owner/Admin sets/moves/postpones/recommits canonical planned local date under unchanged reviewed state with real YYYY-MM-DD validation and note≤2000. Planning/scheduled/postponed/completed remain explicit; no-op/replay returns original recorded outcome and date/status journal. Moving date does not rewrite task due dates/assignments/status or move phase.

title: Launch date/status journal and actor names
behavior: Launch journal reads scoped before/after planned/actual date/status, event kind, actual actor and occurrence/correction history. Minimal deleted-actor attribution remains without private account payload. Read failure is unavailable, not a fabricated empty journal.

title: Nine Playbook milestones and 23 linked preparation tasks
behavior: First schedule and fixed nine Playbook milestones/23 actual source undated ordinary launch_prep Tasks initialize in one bounded history, audit and the recorded outcome transaction with stable seed identities. Preserve approved wording and existing user edits/deletions; task system owns assignee/date/status. Three actual prelaunch_practice occurrences supply their own evidence; task ticks never fabricate those events.

title: Complete and reopen milestones with a fresh linked-task view
behavior: Complete or reopen a readiness milestone under current subject authority and unchanged reviewed state in the same history, audit and the recorded outcome transaction. Completion is allowed with open linked tasks. The linked-task digest compares the reviewed view with current linked tasks and refuses only a stale view; it does not require tasks to be complete. Reopening or correcting linked work makes current evidence Needs review while preserving prior human completion history. Guest/debrief evidence is derived and cannot be overridden by a manual checkbox.

title: Complete/reopen linked launch task using ordinary task rules
behavior: Complete/reopen linked Launch prep Tasks only through ordinary task subject/assignee/administration rules. Current milestone progress derives from live Tasks; task deletion/reassignment/reopen changes that projection and never erases prior human completion or gains a Launch authorization bypass.

title: Record Launch Sunday outcome once date arrives
behavior: Record actual nonfuture Launch date/count/outcome separately from target, link real named guests with atomic same-plant Person/relation create or explicit existing selection, and save/submit versioned six-area debrief. A valid submitted No-unentered-guests derives guest_data_entered Met; Yes/positive count derives Not met; draft/unanswered Unknown. Valid submission independently derives debrief_done Met. Separately preview/review/publish human summary under current scoped sharing; no automatic task/contact/email/phase/guest placeholder.

title: Correct recorded outcome with journal/no-op semantics
behavior: Correct canonical actual Launch/date/count/debrief/guest relation/summary under unchanged reviewed state with before/after actor/history and no-op replay. New incomplete draft preserves last valid submitted evidence. Corrected guest answer updates current derived criterion without erasing old snapshot or silently demoting phase; aggregate headcount/missing count never silently recalc from roster.

title: Launch workspace, dashboard countdown and outcome forms
behavior: Launch workspace/dashboard uses one church-local countdown and canonical planned/status/actual outcome/readiness facts, explicitly distinguishes zero/unknown/postponed/overdue/completed and exposes named-guest/debrief/summary workflow. Calendar 0..28 day window is distinct from 48 hour follow-up and 72 hour result-release clocks; load error is unavailable.

title: Converge missing readiness after seed failure
behavior: Repair partial initialization by stable launch/milestone/task seed identity under current plant/source state, creating incomplete-initialization items exactly once. Retained seed receipts and task/link tombstones distinguish deliberate user deletion, which repair never resurrects. Existing edits/completion/history survive and no arbitrary recurring service or automatic readiness completion is created.

title: Milestone completion history and named actor
behavior: Read milestone completion, reopening and correction history with the actual named actor or minimal scrubbed deleted attribution and original event times. Reconfirmation uses the current linked-task digest and allows open tasks. Keep prior completion history without relabelling it as a new past fact.

title: Recurring services and worship/volunteer scheduling boundary
behavior: Recurring post-launch services/worship/volunteer scheduling is outside the active target; source declarations create no operation. Phase-six post-launch 48 hour guest follow-up remains Unknown/unmeasured without an approved actual obligations/contact/time origin, never substituted by prelaunch Vision success.

title: Canonical SME Launch Playbook source
behavior: Package exact canonical original Playbook bytes hash d365dd4992156e674f8e67601239fbf97c173074a3ca7e0bc8010aa725205e7a; welcome article is not a substitute. No source rewrite or customer migration.

title: Approved global Wiki article/section bootstrap
behavior: Fresh global bootstrap preserves unchanged 96 published global article / 21 sections / seven system template payload, canonical IDs/slugs/source checksums/ancestry/links. No customer/tenant/progress/feedback/private/vector import.

title: Eleven generated document template catalog
behavior: Preserve eleven original document template catalog entries, meaningful generated document/private exact byte/history workflow; approved optional operational copying never silently overwrites tenant work.

title: Twenty phase/launch checklist templates
behavior: Preserve twenty phase/launch checklist templates and the verified canonical launch inventory of nine milestone keys and 23 exact ordinary task identities. Explicit offers/selective import remain optional; no forced structure, automatic launch-derived task dates or resurrection of deliberately deleted work. The source inventory manifest governs the count; the historical 22 prose count is not authority to drop a task.

title: Ten predefined ministry teams and role/responsibility catalog
behavior: Preserve ten predefined team and role/responsibility template catalog bytes; actual eight methodology areas+separate Prayer responsibility map explicitly, selected imports only, no name guess/coordinator substitution.

title: Seven system communication templates
behavior: Preserve seven original global system communication templates and hashes; use current compose/review/delivery rules, not runtime authority from reference text.

title: Global methodology embeddings bootstrap
behavior: Build complete pinned methodology corpus from exact authorized inputs with source/passage hashes, chunker, embedding model/dimensions and generation. Removed/stale trailing chunks retired; old unproven vectors not imported.

title: Reference package verification and editorial approval gate
behavior: Reference release validates complete hash/key/link/syntax/semantic inputs and derivatives before atomic expected-generation activation; failed build preserves active, rollback creates a new activation retaining history. Original rubric+separate NI reference currentness documented; model/runtime proof future gate.

title: Application-only policy and fixed pastoral boundary
behavior: Evry handles application work and recorded evidence. It refuses pastoral or Biblical counsel, prayer composition, spiritual suitability judgments and responsibility as a leader. Literal user-supplied prayer-related task titles remain ordinary task data; user or source text never grants authority.

title: Fresh tenancy, account and per-operation permission
behavior: Before every operation and retained-reference read, recheck the authenticated account, exact current tenant context, subject lifecycle and operation permission. A page, model-selected ID, CRM role, citation or organization affiliation cannot create authority. Organization reads use only their exact enabled shared projections; private care and its existence remain excluded.

title: Authorized read registration and bounded source artifacts
behavior: Register only operations flagged as model tools, under their native authority and purpose projections. Authorized reads and nonpersistent drafts need no write approval; return bounded results with source references, completeness, exclusions and whether more results exist, letting the user get the next page. Native-only and internal operations are not model tools.

title: Measured model selection and server-side provider options
behavior: Choose a qualified model from measured task/effect evaluations with server-held provider settings. Record normalized usage and truthful provider failures; a model choice or routing hint never enlarges authority. Provider purchases and configuration need their own approval.

title: Global launcher and contextual conversation panel
behavior: Open Evry from the global launcher or contextual panel and retain the same private conversation when the native page or panel presentation changes. A different tenancy context requires an explicit permitted choice. The design panel shows messages, reviews, progress and factual outcomes.

title: Visible page context and safe entity references
behavior: Use visible page context and authorized entity references as presentation hints. Resolve every referenced record under current scope and purpose before model use; stale, revoked, foreign and private-care references are removed rather than used as permission.

title: Contextual suggestions and eligibility probe
behavior: Offer contextual suggestions only for currently eligible application operations. Eligibility is advisory and grants no permission; dispatch rechecks authority. Unsupported work has a truthful boundary response rather than a registered no-op tool.

title: Durable conversations, search, messages and replay
behavior: Persist conversations and submitted messages privately for one initiating account in one exact account, plant or organization context. List, search, read and replay only that account's eligible conversations, with fresh lifecycle and retained-reference checks. Reconnect does not duplicate a submitted turn or domain effect.

title: Bounded structured references, choices and context
behavior: Compile bounded context from at most 24 recent messages, 32,000 context tokens, 64 verified references and 16,000 characters per retrieved section. Remove forbidden references before each model call. If Evry cannot shorten the context, it keeps drafts and saved outcomes and asks one narrow question; summaries cannot authorize execution.

title: Read, clarification, review, progress, outcome and boundary cards
behavior: Show source-bound read, clarification, review, progress, receipt and boundary cards. Cards distinguish recorded facts, unknown/unavailable results and proposed effects; model text cannot impersonate trusted approval controls or claim an unsaved outcome.

title: Changed proposals invalidate prior approval
behavior: Approval applies only to the exact content the user reviewed: targets, arguments, exclusions, dates, audience, files and consequences. Any change to a reviewed fact needs a new approval.

title: Trusted visible approval, cancellation and expiration
behavior: Every durable domain, file or outbound effect requires a visible trusted exact review and human approval. Approval belongs to the approving account and context, covers only the reviewed content, and lapses after 15 minutes; conversational yes alone is insufficient. Cancelled, superseded or expired approval cannot start an unresolved effect.

title: Executor, partial results, dependency skips and safe retry
behavior: Execute only unresolved effects covered by the current exact approval and fresh authority/unchanged reviewed state checks. Preserve required consequence ordering, partial outcomes and truthful skips. Lost responses return known outcomes; retry only declared safe unresolved effects of the same approved action. Unknown provider outcomes require reconciliation before another attempt.

title: Approved actions run once with a matching audit record
behavior: Only work covered by the initiating account, acting context and exact current human approval may execute. Each executed effect writes its audit record together with the change, and its history and known outcome agree. Supported closed outcome values: completed, partial, failed, refused, unknown. Repeating or reconnecting to a completed action returns its recorded outcome without repeating effects. Expired, cancelled or replaced execution cannot publish. The representation of execution ownership and saved outcomes follows Everyfield patterns. Recording an outcome creates no new domain permission.

title: Deterministic recipes and dependency-output reuse
behavior: Compose reviewed recipes from the same domain operations, resolving prerequisite outputs explicitly. Meeting invitation review includes meeting creation, guests and outbound invitation together. Domain drafts, scheduled sends, reschedules, cancellations and replacements each require exact review; recipes never create autonomous send authority.

title: One active run per conversation, with streaming and recovery
behavior: Allow at most one active run per account, acting context and conversation. Stream progress and recover interrupted runs from factual saved state. A run that loses execution ownership stops further work and cannot publish. Resuming work preserves committed outcomes and executes only still-authorized unresolved effects. Lease duration, renewal and ownership representation follow Everyfield patterns.

title: Plant-local natural-language date resolution
behavior: Resolve natural-language dates in the authorized plant timezone with explicit local dates, times and DST ambiguity choices. Include the exact resolution in review; clarification is required when the intended date cannot be established. A model date never silently changes scheduling semantics.

title: Append-only product audit and exact-plan inspection
behavior: Retain append-only product audit and exact proposal/effect identity with current review inspection and recorded outcomes. Reads remain scoped and omit private care and forbidden body data. Audit history records actual outcomes and does not imply approval, permission or implementation.

title: Cost, latency, usage normalization and privacy-safe Langfuse tracing
behavior: Record content-free cost, latency and normalized input/output usage with safe run/build correlation. Optional Langfuse tracing excludes prompts, private content, credentials and private-care existence or metadata. Telemetry failure cannot change a domain result.

title: Generated model-tool exposure through reviewed Evry adapters
behavior: Every operation flagged as a model tool is exposed through the reviewed Evry adapter. The generated list in docs/catalog/evry-tools.json derives from operations.json model_tool flags. Native actor, purpose, privacy, review and correction rules still apply. Operations not flagged as model tools remain excluded; catalog membership never grants authority.

title: Owned conversation runtime and private session access
behavior: Conversations, turns, saved reviews and approved effects remain app-owned and recoverable. Native and Evry calls use the same domain policy and outcomes. Reconnect, replay, interruption and retry preserve factual progress without authorizing or duplicating effects. Storage and background execution follow Everyfield patterns; no per-feature execution protocol is required. Session ownership stays private to the initiating account and exact context. Transport exposes only allowed application operations and grants no arbitrary code, network, filesystem, SQL or approval capability.

title: Tool catalog loading and optional workflow hints
behavior: Load available tools from the generated model-tool list under current context and purpose. Optional workflow hints may guide planning but cannot register hidden tools, change permissions or replace exact approval. Builders choose schemas and internal types in code.

title: Editable planning notes, clarifications and todo
behavior: Keep editable planning notes (a stale edit is refused), clarifications and todo state as bounded candidate conversation context. Saving assistant protocol state does not authorize domain effects. Submitted user messages, review revisions and actual outcomes remain distinguishable.

title: Source-bound result cards and compatible selection
behavior: Return source-bound result cards and allow compatible selection only from returned authorized rows. Selection cannot expand a result set or invent IDs, and current access is checked before reuse. Say when more results exist, and keep exclusions and completeness visible.

title: Staged private file manifests, session binding and cleanup
behavior: Attachments stay private to the account, context and session. An attached file the user reviewed cannot change before import. Only eligible files attach, imports follow native rules, and unused attachments are removed. A staged file is not a domain import or publication approval.

title: Bounded parallel composition of authorized reads
behavior: Compose at most eight declared authorized reads in parallel and count each actual read against the same 24-call turn budget. Read composition exposes no arbitrary code, filesystem, network, SQL, durable command executor or approval capability.

title: Optional routing experiments and measured evaluation
behavior: Optional discovery or routing experiments use measured evaluations of the same authorized operations. Routing hints and SDK wrappers are optional implementation choices, never mandatory dependencies or authority. Experiments cannot bypass review, privacy or current scope.

title: Eleven authored operational workflow skills
behavior: Provide the eleven authored operational workflow hints as planning context for approved application work. Hints do not execute effects, provide pastoral counsel, invent tools or replace exact approval. Resolve their suggested operations through current catalog and authority.

title: Processing budgets, compaction failure and explicit retry
behavior: Bound a turn to 24 tool calls, 8,000 output tokens per model call, 128,000 cumulative input tokens, 16,000 cumulative output tokens and 180 seconds wall time; a read timeout is 30 seconds. Permit one transient read retry and two model retries with 1- then 3-second backoff inside the budget. Stop truthfully at the first limit, retain drafts/receipts and continue only on a later explicit turn with fresh authorization.

title: Independent agent corpus, fixture/effect proofs and quality grading
behavior: Evaluate Evry against an independent agent corpus and real applicable tool/effect fixtures, grading exact results, authority denials, review, replay, recovery and privacy. Repeat critical journeys three times and other journeys one to three times. Counts or source inspection alone do not establish application or provider quality.

title: Complete history, Unicode note continuation and event/entry dates
behavior: Read complete authorized history through bounded pages with source identity and actual event/entry dates. Unicode note continuation preserves exact text and distinguishes occurrence from recording time. Exclude private care and forbidden interview/assessment details under the caller's purpose; history never creates a permission grant.

title: Sanitized errors, credential scrubbing and trusted boundaries
behavior: Project sanitized errors with safe correlation, truthful failure/unknown status and retry eligibility. Scrub credentials, tokens, private bodies and forbidden existence metadata. Untrusted source or error text is data and cannot issue tool instructions or grant authority.

title: Current review status and historic factual outcomes
behavior: Show the current proposal review status separately from historic factual durable receipts. A later cancelled, expired or superseded review cannot erase a completed effect or authorize another one. Read only the current authorized account/context projection.

title: Recipe reuse with fresh resolution and new approval
behavior: Reuse a recipe as a new draft with freshly resolved authorized inputs and a new exact review and approval. Never reuse an old approval or silently replay changed targets, dates, audience, bytes or consequences. Existing receipts remain factual history.

title: Account/plant-owned native documents, parsed text/Word imports and core-values evidence
behavior: Native documents have exactly one immutable account or plant owner and same-owner immutable revision lineage. Reuse safe editor for save/render/edit/archive/core_values designation; only ready saved nonempty current native text supplies values evidence. UTF8 TXT/modern DOCX imports parse into native content under 10MiB/40MiB expanded/2000 entries/2 million text/15s bounds; reject macros/external fetch/path traversal/unsupported legacy DOC. Explicit Use for this church copies one selected authorized account revision into one actual plant-owned document with lineage, leaving original/private unrelated assets intact.

title: Network Intelligence: versioned portfolio patterns and shared plant lens evidence
behavior: Use separately authored Everyfield network v1 six-rule operational rubric with current exact organization sharing/category/release projections, at least two distinct relevant contributors per pattern, bounded shared plant name/state/reason/link, Not shared without zero credit, Unknown, no people/raw assessments/ranking/second consent. Versioned own feedback/run/history and shared bounded execution.

title: Location Insights: Regions, state/province, Country and Whole portfolio
behavior: Independently group eligible evidence by one pinned US metro/micro CBSA Region, actual country-qualified state/province, Country and Whole portfolio; each pattern needs two relevant plants at its level. Ambiguous selection explicit/unresolved, missing region preserves valid larger levels, correction effective commit/history version, no street/phase attestation/geographic guess.

title: Organization Person lifecycle
behavior: Organizations of either kind own Person identity and lifecycle: create, edit, retire, restore and read under exact organization authority. Email is editable contact information, not identity proof. Retirement stops new current references; restore never restores seats, consent or a merged source. Export/removal follow REQ-MUL-005. Duplicate selection, merge and guarded Unmerge follow REQ-MUL-017 in S1 WP-015, consuming the S0 reference/inverse interface. Every new Person consumer registers retirement, merge and inverse behavior before closure. Plant recruitment, household, commitment and ministry facts remain plant-only; organization stage kinds never enter plant progression.

title: Pipeline duty authority and restricted projections
behavior: A current exact-organization Owner or Admin can administer its pipeline. Assigned responsible staff and program directors must hold a current eligible seat in that organization and receive only their named duties. A linked resident has only their own residency projection, without an organization seat or directory access. Internal stage labels, reasons, staff conversation notes, assessment metadata and inactivity flags are hidden from residents. No director or organization role gains plant editing, account-private documents, reflections, private-care bodies or existence signals. Central audit contains IDs, actor, change kind and revisions, never protected note, reason or feedback bodies. The S0 portion proves exact duty decisions and restricted note projections against supplied records. Rendering pipeline stage labels is a later WP-098 projection; program directors do not gain responsible-staff note access merely by directing a program.

title: Resident consent and revocation foundation
behavior: An accepted resident link records separate choices for sharing six-foundation completion and resident milestone progress with the exact organization. Disclose categories and excluded private content before acceptance; acceptance grants only explicitly chosen categories. The resident can stop either category or leave. Withdrawal takes effect immediately in current reads, exports, saved results, history, jobs, source bytes and model context; stale consent revisions fail. Account-private reading and documents remain account-owned. A link neither creates a seat nor consumes another seat. An ended link cannot be revived by replaying an invitation or an old approval. Enrollment facts the organization independently owns remain subject to its removal policy; consent loss does not erase genuine organizational facts.

title: Organization invitation to a resident account
behavior: An organization Owner or Admin may invite a specific pipeline person to link an Everyfield account. Use sealed, expiring, purpose-bound invitation proof, the exact organization and Person, and verified addressed-account acceptance. Names or matching emails alone never authorize a link. The person sees the disclosure and accepts or declines without acquiring a seat. Decline leaves their account unchanged. Revoke, resend, retire, remove, concurrent claim and expiry recheck current facts at commit; one accepted link and receipt survive retries, never two accounts or two people. Public invitation responses do not reveal whether an account exists. A pending personal deletion or foreign owner refuses acceptance.

title: Organization pipeline export and removal
behavior: An exact-organization Owner or Admin exports current authorized pipeline contact, stage history, program and attributable completion facts in a safe downloadable format. Export omits account-private content and any note, reason, feedback or progress category unavailable to the current reader; recheck authority and consent when producing and downloading bytes. On a person removal request, remove identifiable pipeline/contact bodies and unnecessary note, reason and feedback bodies, revoke links and source access, and retain only independently needed organization facts with minimal scope-local attribution. Report retained categories and why. Retirement is not removal. No permanent history exception, fixed new retention period or account 30-day cancellation period applies to organization pipeline records. Account removal severs account links and purges account-private originals without erasing independently needed organization facts. Recovery must reapply removal and revocation witnesses before service reopens.

title: Residency handoff interface preserves ordinary creation
behavior: The foundation creation interface accepts only account-owner-confirmed values and preserves ordinary Phase 1 entry, one active seat and an attributable creation event. A sending organization cannot create or edit the plant on the resident's behalf. Residency commissioning, plant prefill and lineage are deferred to ADR delivery stage 3. Future handoff must explicitly resolve an existing organization staff seat; an Owner follows the existing manual exceptional ownership process. No seat-transfer engine or silent geographic attestation is introduced.

title: Sending goals and observed counts
behavior: Both sending churches and sending networks may record multiple goals with nonnegative leader and plant targets, target year and rationale. At a stated as-of instant in the organization timezone, show own-pipeline counts by each fixed stage kind: count distinct live same-organization people whose current pipeline stage has that kind. A person appears once; retired or merged people and foreign organizations do not count. Also show active residents: distinct live same-organization people with at least one active enrollment in a residency-kind program; apprenticeship enrollment and the editable pipeline label alone do not qualify. Multiple active residency programs still count the person once. These are current observations, not forecasts, readiness scores or an undefined total of leaders. Plant targets may be stored, but observed plants sent is unavailable with reason deferred_stage_3 until commissioning/lineage arrives in stage 3; do not substitute zero or count Commissioned-kind people as plants. Aggregate church/network sharing remains stage 4. A goal never moves a person, commissions an enrollment or creates a plant.

title: Configurable human pipeline stages
behavior: Start with Potential leader, Apprentice, Resident, Commissioned and Not continuing. Owners and Admins may rename, reorder and add stages mapped to the fixed kinds potential_leader, apprentice, resident, commissioned, not_continuing or other. Show exact changes for review before saving. Refuse deletion of occupied stages and retain old labels in dated history. A human records each move and its reason; no automatic recruitment event or program completion moves an organization person. Not continuing is an ordinary outcome. Record only whether an outside assessment occurred, when and by whom, never its outcome. Staff may query people with no move for six months using the stated calendar and as-of date. Counts use kinds, not editable labels. Evry may propose only the selected Person and destination stage identities. The proposal does not move anyone and accepts no note, reason or other free text. A human completes an exact native review and supplies the required reason outside model/conversation input; the native move rechecks current authority and revisions.

title: Leadership conversations
behavior: Current authorized staff log who met whom and the actual conversation date. Count conversations in the organization timezone by month or quarter. The optional short note is readable only by the organization Owner, Admins and the person currently responsible. Other staff may receive permitted counts, never note contents or existence through filtering, search or exports. Resident projections omit staff notes. Conversation notes never enter model input, including calls made by an otherwise authorized reader. Changes retain attributable correction history without judging a person. Logging leadership conversations is human-only. Organization ordinary Person notes use the same Owner/Admin or responsible-staff audience and never enter models. Only the original author with current exact-organization duty may update or remove such a note; removal clears the body and retains only necessary attributable body-free history.

title: Apprenticeship and residency program definitions
behavior: Both apprenticeship and residency programs ship before alpha for either organization kind. Define director, meeting rhythm, expected length, ordered stages with editable month ranges, milestones and Wiki reading lists. Start blank or from the residency template: Assimilating 2 to 3 months, Training and planning 6 to 9 months, Gathering 2 to 3 months, Sending and planting 2 to 3 months. Offer milestones to start a small group and raise a replacement, present the vision to sending leadership and write a church planting prospectus. Directors review drafts before publication. Publishing a changed plan creates a new version; existing enrollments keep their plan unless the director deliberately reviews and applies the version. Reading pointers pin canonical article and revision and recheck current source entitlement; organization content never grants general library access.

title: Enrollment, cohort and deliberate plan changes
behavior: Enroll an active same-organization pipeline person in a program and cohort with start, expected end, current program stage, status and next meeting with timezone. A person may have different programs but cannot have duplicate active enrollment in the same program. Enrollment fixes the published version and its milestones. A director may explicitly apply a reviewed new version to selected enrollments, preserving attributable completion/confirmation history and exposing added, removed or changed work. Reject foreign person, director, program or stage and changed reviewed states. Current program stages are distinct from internal pipeline stages.

title: Resident completion, director confirmation and feedback
behavior: A currently linked resident marks their own milestone complete; the current program director confirms separately. Resident completion never supplies director confirmation. For an enrollee without a current accepted resident link in this organization, the current program director may instead record the enrollee completion and confirm it in one dated, attributable native action. That action records the director as recorder and confirmer, the actual completion instant and confirmation instant, and a program-leader-recorded source; the enrolled Person remains the subject. It creates no account link or seat and cannot be used while a current resident link exists. Recheck link status at commit, so a concurrent acceptance refuses this path and requires the linked-resident flow. A subsequent link does not rewrite prior director-recorded facts. Retain correction history for each fact. Hands-on assignments are described milestones; dated feedback is visible only to the linked resident, current director and organization Owner/Admin of either kind. Other staff and foreign residents cannot read feedback. Feedback does not judge calling. Recheck duty, version, link and consent at use. Neither completion path automatically commissions or creates a plant.

title: My residency without a seat
behavior: A linked Discovery account keeps its private Wiki reading and documents and gains My residency showing its program, current program stage, next meeting, own milestones and confirmation state, entitled reading list and exact sharing controls. It can mark its own milestone done, stop sharing or leave. It cannot see the internal pipeline label, reasons, staff notes, assessment metadata or six-month inactivity flag. It receives no People, Meetings, Tasks, Launch, organization directory, plant workspace or second seat. Current link loss removes the projection immediately, including cached navigation and downloads.

title: Consented foundations and reading sources
behavior: A director sees only the linked resident's consented completion facts for the six canonical Discovery foundations and permitted milestone progress. Do not return private reading rows, reflections or documents. Foundation completion means one eligible actual reader completed all six above the existing threshold; do not pool readers or infer completion from a program milestone. Program reading uses current entitled canonical sources, including the organization's published versions. Withdrawal, link termination, source unpublication or lost relationship access removes content and shared progress from current results, history and downloadable bytes. Linking does not broaden Discovery reading rights to unrelated organization libraries.

title: Pipeline and residency Evry boundaries
behavior: Evry may read authorized pipeline facts and draft program plans and milestone lists. Every durable write uses exact human review of all effects and fresh authority, reference, revision and consent checks at execution. Native and assistant calls have the same results and denials. Staff may ask who has not moved in six months. Evry never ranks people, assesses calling or reads leadership conversation notes into a model; it also excludes private care, internal reasons, assessment metadata and assignment feedback unless a separately reviewed model-safe allowlist explicitly authorizes a category. Program drafting never publishes or enrolls without reviewed effects. Agreement and commissioning drafts remain deferred with delivery stage 3. Conversation logging and reason-bearing stage moves are native-only. A bounded stage-move proposal accepts only Person and destination stage identities and refuses any note/reason/free-text field. It returns a draft with no durable effect; human review collects the reason outside the conversation/model and commits the native operation. Model context and receipts omit that human-only body.

title: Network sharing boundary and deferred delivery
behavior: A sending-church Owner or Admin may opt in to sharing pipeline totals separately for each current network relationship and withdraw immediately. Default is off. Share only aggregate stage-kind counts, active residents and commissioned counts by year, never individual candidates, notes, reasons, feedback, assessment metadata or private progress. A network result requires at least two currently contributing organizations; hide unavailable contributions rather than substituting zero or allowing subtraction, filters, saved history or stale jobs to identify a single church or person. A network's own pipeline confers no right to a church's pipeline. Aggregate delivery, network-defined church stages and revised Network Intelligence inputs remain deferred to ADR stage 4; S0 establishes only consent/revocation categories and minimum-contributor rules. The S0 eligibility check returns only an allowed/withheld decision and the minimum contributor rule, without totals or individual records; it rechecks current opt-ins and refuses fewer than two distinct contributors.

title: Organization duplicates, merge and guarded Unmerge
behavior: In S1, reuse the Person correction and merge producer for organization-owned identities. Duplicate suggestions never prove identity or choose a survivor automatically. An exact-organization Owner or Admin reviews the selected source, survivor and field choices. Merge requires reviewed field choices, current reviewed state and same-owner identities, preserves historical endpoints and refuses linked-account, enrollment or other current-reference collisions. Unmerge restores only the exact reviewed prior state and refuses conflicting edits, new references or irreversible disclosure. No merge or inverse transfers account consent, private care, note authorship or organization/plant authority. Register downstream enrollment, stage-history and resident-link collisions before those consumers close.
